This Windows/pwsh chezmoi repo (`dotfiles-windows`) is a companion to the
cross-platform macOS/Linux repo `daviddwlee84/dotfiles`, checked out on this
machine at `/Users/david/.local/share/chezmoi` (the default chezmoi source).
When porting a shell feature "the way the unix side does it", read that repo —
its full alias/keymap catalogs live under `docs/shells/` (e.g.
`docs/shells/aliases.md`).

The unix zsh uses the **oh-my-zsh built-in `git` plugin** as-is
(`~/.oh-my-zsh/plugins/git/git.plugin.zsh`, ~200 aliases) — that file is the
authoritative source of truth for git-alias parity, not memory. The user has
strong omz git muscle memory (prefers `gst` for status, expects `gl` = `git
pull`). The pwsh port of it lives in `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/21_git.ps1`
(see [[.]] repo). Two pwsh gotchas that bit this port: built-in aliases outrank
same-named functions, and command names are case-insensitive — captured in
`pitfalls/function-shadowed-by-builtin-alias-and-case-insensitive.md`.
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
Summary — what Weasel is
- Weasel is the Windows distribution of the Rime input method engine (Rime for Windows). It’s described as "【小狼毫】Rime for Windows" and the project is GPLv3-licensed.
- It targets Windows 8.1 through Windows 11 and provides Rime input with Windows-specific UI and packaging.

How to install on Windows
- The repository supplies an installer. On first run the installer shows an "安裝選項" dialog where you choose input language (to register for Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) pick "中文（臺灣）") and click Install.
- After installation you can reopen installation options from the Start menu to change the input language.
- The page does not mention winget, scoop, or any other package manager, nor does it document any silent-install command-line switches.

Where user configuration and data live
- User files, dictionaries, and configuration are placed in: "%AppData%\Rime"
- The Start-menu item includes a "用戶文件夾" entry to open that folder.

What default.custom.yaml / weasel.custom.yaml do
- The page does not list exact filenames, but it explains that user configuration files and user dictionaries in %AppData%\Rime are how you customize Rime.
- For Weasel-specific style and behavior changes the repo points to its Wiki; in other words, user YAML files in the Rime user folder are used to override defaults and to apply Weasel-specific customizations (see the repo Wiki for exact file names and schema).

How to apply changes / reload configuration
- After editing dictionaries or configuration files you must "重新部署" to make changes take effect (that is the documented deploy/reload step).
- For switching input schemes or quickly toggling modes, use the input indicator menu or the hotkeys (Ctrl+` or F4) to open the scheme menu.

Installer elevation / reboot notes
- The documentation does not state any required administrator privileges, nor does it mention that a reboot is required.
- No silent-install switches or unattended-install options are documented on the page.

Useful links (as referenced on the page)
- Project site: https://rime.im
- Weasel Wiki (for Weasel-specific customization): https://github.com/rime/weasel/wiki
- General Rime customization guide: https://github.com/rime/home/wiki/CustomizationGuide
- Issue tracker / feedback: https://github.com/rime/weasel/issues

Quoted excerpts (each <=125 chars)
- "【小狼毫】Rime for Windows"
- "安裝選項"
- "%AppData%\\Rime"
- "重新部署"

If you want, I can fetch the Weasel Wiki pages and README to list exact custom YAML filenames and example snippets for common customizations.
```

26	# the end, never fatal — one bad manifest must not abort the rest of the install
27	# (nor the rest of `chezmoi apply`). Mirrors ansible allow-partial-failure.
28	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
29	if (Test-Path variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) { $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false }
30	$script:Failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
31	
32	# UTF-8 console so winget's localized output isn't mojibake on zh-* Windows.
33	try { [Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false) } catch { $null = $_ }
34	{{ if .useChineseMirror }}
35	# China (GFW) mirrors for install-time package fetches.
36	$env:PIP_INDEX_URL = 'https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple'
37	$env:UV_DEFAULT_INDEX = 'https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple'
38	$env:npm_config_registry = 'https://registry.npmmirror.com'
39	$env:GOPROXY = 'https://goproxy.cn,direct'
40	$env:MISE_NODE_MIRROR_URL = 'https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/node/'
41	{{ end }}
42	
43	function Info($m) { Write-Host "==> $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
44	function Have($n) { [bool](Get-Command $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) }
45	function Register-Failure($what) { $script:Failures.Add($what); Write-Warning "FAILED (skipped): $what" }
46	
47	# --- scoop -----------------------------------------------------------------
48	function Test-Admin {
49	    # $true when this pwsh is running elevated (member of the Administrators role).
50	    try {
51	        $id = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
52	        ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal]$id).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
53	    } catch { $false }
54	}
55	
56	function Ensure-Scoop {
57	    if (-not (Have scoop)) {
58	        # get.scoop.sh returns install.ps1's text. Piping it to Invoke-Expression
59	        # works in a normal console, but an ELEVATED one is refused ("Running the
60	        # installer as administrator is disabled by default") unless -RunAsAdmin is
61	        # passed. Some dev boxes always open the shell as admin, so detect that and
62	        # forward the flag. We build a scriptblock from the fetched text so we can
63	        # pass args -- equivalent to `iex "& {$(irm get.scoop.sh)} -RunAsAdmin"`.
64	        $installer = [scriptblock]::Create((Invoke-RestMethod get.scoop.sh))
65	        if (Test-Admin) {
66	            Info 'scoop not found — installing (elevated console: passing -RunAsAdmin)'
67	            & $installer -RunAsAdmin
68	        } else {
69	            Info 'scoop not found — installing (user-scoped, no admin)'
70	            & $installer
71	        }
72	    }
73	    foreach ($b in 'main', 'extras', 'versions', 'nerd-fonts') {
74	        scoop bucket add $b *> $null
75	    }
76	}
77	
78	function Get-ScoopInstalled {
79	    try { return @((scoop export | ConvertFrom-Json).apps.name) } catch { return @() }
80	}
81	
82	function Scoop-Install([string[]]$apps) {
83	    if (-not $apps) { return }
84	    # Wrap in @() so a lone survivor stays an array. Without it PowerShell
85	    # unwraps a single match to a bare string, and `scoop install @missing`
86	    # then splats it one CHARACTER per arg => "Couldn't find manifest for 'm'"
87	    # when only "mise" was missing.
88	    $missing = @($apps | Where-Object { ($_ -split '/')[-1] -notin (Get-ScoopInstalled) })
89	    if (-not $missing) { Info 'scoop: all requested tools already present'; return }
90	    Info "scoop install: $($missing -join ', ')"
91	    try { scoop install @missing } catch { Write-Warning "scoop batch error: $_" }
92	    # Anything still absent after the batch = failed (scoop keeps going past a bad one).
93	    $after = Get-ScoopInstalled
94	    foreach ($app in $missing) {
95	        $name = ($app -split '/')[-1]
96	        if ($name -notin $after) { Register-Failure "scoop:$name" }
97	    }
98	}
99	
100	# --- winget ----------------------------------------------------------------
101	function Winget-Install([string]$id) {
102	    if (-not (Have winget)) { Register-Failure "winget:$id (winget unavailable)"; return }
103	    winget list --id $id -e --accept-source-agreements *> $null
104	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { return }   # already installed
105	    Info "winget install $id"
106	    winget install --id $id -e --silent --scope user `
107	        --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
108	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
109	        # some packages don't support --scope user; retry machine scope.
110	        winget install --id $id -e --silent `
111	            --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
112	    }
113	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure "winget:$id" }
114	}

118	# official ChatGPT desktop app. msstore ignores --scope, so we don't pass it.
119	function Winget-InstallStore([string]$id) {

121	    winget list --id $id -e --accept-source-agreements *> $null
122	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { return }   # already installed
123	    Info "winget (msstore) install $id"
124	    winget install --id $id -e --source msstore --silent `
125	        --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
126	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure "msstore:$id" }
127	}

<tool-use data-tool-type="read" data-tool-name="Read"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Read**</summary>
 `./tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1`

```text
1	#Requires -Version 7
2	# Guards hard invariant #1 (AGENTS.md): every init prompt in .chezmoi.toml.tmpl
3	# must have a matching non-interactive flag in .github/workflows/windows.yml.
4	#
5	# Why this exists: adding a prompt without the flag does not fail loudly at
6	# authoring time — it fails much later, on the Windows runner, as an opaque
7	#   error calling promptChoiceOnce: EOF
8	# because `chezmoi init --no-tty` has no answer for the new question and hits
9	# end-of-input. That broke CI for three consecutive pushes when `agentSounds`
10	# was added. This test turns that into a local `Invoke-Pester` failure with the
11	# exact missing flag line to paste in.
12	#
13	# Matching is on the prompt's TEXT (3rd arg to promptXOnce), because that is
14	# what chezmoi's `--promptBool 'text=value'` parser keys on — not the variable
15	# name.
16	
17	BeforeAll {
18	    $repo = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
19	    $tomlTmpl = Join-Path $repo '.chezmoi.toml.tmpl'
20	    $workflow = Join-Path $repo '.github/workflows/windows.yml'
21	
22	    # promptBoolOnce . "varName" "Prompt text" <default>
23	    $script:Prompts = [regex]::Matches(
24	        (Get-Content -Raw $tomlTmpl),
25	        'prompt(?<kind>Bool|String|Choice)Once\s+\.\s+"(?<var>[^"]+)"\s+"(?<text>[^"]+)"'
26	    ) | ForEach-Object {
27	        [pscustomobject]@{
28	            Kind = $_.Groups['kind'].Value
29	            Var  = $_.Groups['var'].Value
30	            Text = $_.Groups['text'].Value
31	        }
32	    }
33	
34	    # '--promptBool','Prompt text=value'
35	    $script:Flags = [regex]::Matches(
36	        (Get-Content -Raw $workflow),
37	        "'--prompt(?<kind>Bool|String|Choice)'\s*,\s*'(?<text>[^=']+)="
38	    ) | ForEach-Object {
39	        [pscustomobject]@{
40	            Kind = $_.Groups['kind'].Value
41	            Text = $_.Groups['text'].Value
42	        }
43	    }
44	}
45	
46	# NB: no angle brackets in Describe/It names — Pester expands `<...>` in test
47	# names as a data placeholder, so a name like "prompts <-> flags" is rewritten
48	# to `$-` and the whole file dies with a bogus CommandNotFoundException.
49	Describe 'init prompts vs CI flags (invariant #1)' {
50	    It 'finds prompts in .chezmoi.toml.tmpl' {
51	        $script:Prompts.Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 10
52	    }
53	
54	    It 'finds prompt flags in windows.yml' {
55	        $script:Flags.Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 10
56	    }
57	
58	    It 'has a CI flag for every init prompt' {
59	        $flagText = @($script:Flags.Text)
60	        $missing = @($script:Prompts | Where-Object { $flagText -notcontains $_.Text })
61	        $hint = ($missing | ForEach-Object {
62	            "            '--prompt$($_.Kind)','$($_.Text)=<value>',   # $($_.Var)"
63	        }) -join "`n"
64	        $missing.Count | Should -Be 0 -Because "windows.yml is missing these flags; add to the `$flags array:`n$hint"
65	    }
66	
67	    It 'has no stale CI flag without a matching prompt' {
68	        # Catches the other half of a rename: the prompt text changed but the
69	        # flag did not. chezmoi silently ignores an unmatched flag and then
70	        # blocks on the real prompt, so this would otherwise be invisible.
71	        $promptText = @($script:Prompts.Text)
72	        $stale = @($script:Flags | Where-Object { $promptText -notcontains $_.Text })
73	        $stale.Count | Should -Be 0 -Because "these windows.yml flags match no prompt: $($stale.Text -join '; ')"
74	    }
75	
76	    It 'uses the right flag kind for each prompt' {
77	        $byText = @{}
78	        foreach ($f in $script:Flags) { $byText[$f.Text] = $f.Kind }
79	        $wrong = @($script:Prompts | Where-Object {
80	            $byText.ContainsKey($_.Text) -and $byText[$_.Text] -ne $_.Kind
81	        })
82	        $wrong.Count | Should -Be 0 -Because "flag kind mismatch for: $($wrong.Var -join '; ')"
83	    }
84	
85	    It 'has no "=" in any prompt text' {
86	        # Invariant #1 corollary: chezmoi's `name=value` parser splits on the
87	        # FIRST "=", so a prompt whose text contains one can never be answered
88	        # non-interactively. This already broke the `role` prompt once.
89	        $bad = @($script:Prompts | Where-Object { $_.Text -match '=' })
90	        $bad.Count | Should -Be 0 -Because "prompt text may not contain '=': $($bad.Var -join '; ')"
91	    }
92	}
93

64	**Docker Desktop's WSL2 backend** (`installWsl` toggle, on for workstation) is set up
65	by `scripts/enable-wsl.ps1` via `wsl --install --no-distribution` — only the WSL2
66	platform, not a Linux distro (Docker creates its own `docker-desktop` distro).
67	`wsl --install` needs admin **and** a reboot, so a non-elevated `chezmoi apply`
68	self-elevates with a single UAC prompt (like scoop), runs the install, then prints a
69	restart notice — reboot, then Docker Desktop starts on the WSL2 backend. Re-run or
70	retry (e.g. if the UAC prompt was declined) with `just enable-wsl`. Already-installed
71	machines are a no-op (no UAC). On a proxy / corporate / GFW network where the WSL app
72	download is reset ("connection reset"), the script falls back to enabling the WSL2
73	features **offline via DISM** and points at the kernel MSI + `wsl --update`. WSL as a
74	*Linux shell* stays out of scope — see
75	[rationale](rationale.md#powershell-7-default-cmdexe-optional-via-clink).
76

79	user via `wsl -u root`, passwordless sudo, WSL auto-login), then — in the default

81	cross-platform dotfiles (`daviddwlee84/dotfiles`, `ubuntu_server` profile) with no
82	prompts inside WSL. `wslUbuntuBootstrap` can instead be `interactive` (the parent repo's
83	prompts on first login) or `none` (set up the distro only). Requires the WSL2 platform
84	(`installWsl`) + its reboot first; run or retry with `just enable-wsl-ubuntu`. Linux GUI
85	apps work out of the box via **WSLg** if you later switch the frozen profile to
86	`ubuntu_desktop`. This is an opt-in *bridge* — the Linux config lives in the
87	cross-platform repo, not here.

1	# Input Methods
2	
3	以 macOS 為主，記錄這個 dotfiles repo 目前使用與追蹤的繁體中文輸入法相關資訊，重點放在：
4	
5	- McBopomofo
6	- Rime / Squirrel
7	- app 切換時的輸入法狀態
8	- `vim_mode`、`ascii_mode`、全局狀態等已知限制
9	- 哪些檔案適合備份，哪些不適合直接納入 chezmoi
10	
11	本文內容以目前這台機器的實際狀態為基準整理，並補上 upstream 文件與 issue / PR 連結。
12	
13	## Related Notes
14	
15	- [macOS System-Level Input Source Switching](macos-system-switching.md): 不依賴 Rime / Squirrel 內建切換時，Apple 原生、Input Source Pro、Hammerspoon、Keyboard Maestro / BetterTouchTool、`macism`、`im-select`、Karabiner 等方案的比較
16	
17	## 本機已驗證的路徑與狀態
18	
19	驗證日期：`2026-03-31`
20	
21	### Squirrel / Rime
22	
23	本機已確認存在：
24	
25	- `~/Library/Rime/squirrel.custom.yaml`
26	- `~/Library/Rime/user.yaml`
27	- `~/Library/Rime/installation.yaml`
28	- `~/Library/Rime/build/`
29	- `~/Library/Rime/sync/<installation_id>/`
30	
31	本機目前狀態：
32	
33	- Squirrel app 存在於 `"/Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app"`
34	- Squirrel `CFBundleVersion` = `1.1.2`
35	- `~/Library/Rime/installation.yaml` 顯示 `distribution_version: 1.1.2`
36	- `~/Library/Rime/installation.yaml` 顯示 `rime_version: 1.16.0`
37	- `~/Library/Rime/sync/43cea773-1593-4ccc-a2f3-a852974cbec4/` 已存在，表示目前有啟用 Rime 同步資料夾
38	
39	### McBopomofo
40	
41	本機已確認存在：
42	
43	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/data.txt`
44	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/data-plain-bpmf.txt`
45	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/exclude-phrases.txt`
46	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/exclude-phrases-plain-bpmf.txt`
47	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/phrases-replacement.txt`
48	- `~/Library/Preferences/org.openvanilla.inputmethod.McBopomofo.plist`
49	- `~/Library/Input Methods/McBopomofo.app`
50	
51	補充：
52	
53	- 這台機器的 McBopomofo 是 user-scope app，位於 `~/Library/Input Methods/`
54	- repo 內目前的 ansible role 只檢查 `/Library/Input Methods/`；這是獨立 follow-up，本文只記錄，不在這一輪修
55	
56	## Rime / Squirrel 自定義
57	
58	Rime 的自定義原則是：不要直接改內建 schema 或發行版 yaml，而是使用 `*.custom.yaml` 搭配 `patch:` 覆寫。這也是官方 wiki 在 [CustomizationGuide](https://github.com/rime/home/wiki/CustomizationGuide) 中反覆使用的做法。
59	
60	macOS 的 Squirrel 對應檔通常是：
61	
62	- `squirrel.custom.yaml`：Squirrel 前端相關設定，例如 `style`、`app_options`
63	- `<schema>.custom.yaml`：特定方案的覆寫，例如 `bopomofo.custom.yaml`
64	- `default.custom.yaml`：全域預設覆寫
65	
66	一個精簡、代表性的 `squirrel.custom.yaml` 例子：
67	
68	```yaml
69	patch:
70	  app_options:
71	    com.microsoft.VSCode:
72	      ascii_mode: true
73	    com.apple.Terminal:
74	      ascii_mode: true
75	      no_inline: true
76	      vim_mode: true
77	      inline_preedit: false
78	```
79	
80	### `app_options`、`ascii_mode`、`no_inline`、`vim_mode`
81	
82	- `app_options`：針對特定 app 的 bundle identifier 設定行為
83	- `ascii_mode: true`：該 app 預設以西文模式起始
84	- `no_inline: true`：停用行內組字，通常在終端或 editor 更穩定
85	- `vim_mode: true`：目標是讓 Vim 類場景在離開 insert mode 時回到西文狀態，但在 macOS Terminal 類 app 上並不可靠
86	- `inline_preedit: false`：常和 `no_inline` 一起使用，降低終端內組字與 `Esc` 互動的干擾
87	
88	這些選項在 Squirrel 內建的 `squirrel.yaml` 就能看到預設示例，例如 `com.apple.Terminal`、`com.googlecode.iterm2`、`org.vim.MacVim`。
89	
90	### 修改後如何生效
91	
92	修改 `*.custom.yaml` 後，需要在 macOS 輸入法選單對鼠鬚管執行「重新佈署」。
93	
94	根據 Rime wiki 的說法，鼠鬚管是在系統語言文字選單中選擇「重新佈署」；對設置的修改會在重新佈署後生效。
95	
96	### 查 app identifier
97	
98	`app_options` 需要 bundle identifier。最直接的查法：
99	
100	```bash
101	osascript -e 'id of app "Visual Studio Code"'
102	osascript -e 'id of app "Terminal"'
103	```
104	
105	本機已驗證：
106	
107	- `Visual Studio Code` -> `com.microsoft.VSCode`
108	- `Terminal` -> `com.apple.Terminal`
109	
110	如果是第三方 app，也可以先用 Finder 確認正式 app 名稱，再用同樣方式查。
111	
112	## 目前最在意的問題
113	
114	### App 切換時輸入法狀態不可靠
115	
116	目前痛點非常明確：在不同視窗或 app 之間切換後，很難確定當前到底是中文還是英文狀態。
117	
118	典型情境：
119	
120	1. 在某個視窗切成英文
121	2. `Command+Tab` 到下一個視窗
122	3. 狀態變成中文
123	4. 再切回原本視窗，狀態仍然可能是中文
124	
125	這不是單靠 `app_options` 就能完全解決的問題。`app_options` 比較像是「進入 app 時的偏好」，不是可靠的全局狀態同步機制。
126	
127	### `vim_mode` 在 Terminal 類 app 上不可靠
128	
129	截至 `2026-03-31`，[`rime/squirrel#1023`](https://github.com/rime/squirrel/issues/1023) 仍是 open，問題標題就是「Terminal Vim_mode 無作用」，描述的現象與目前痛點一致：
130	
131	- VS Code 可部分工作
132	- Terminal 內按 `Esc` 後不一定能回到西文
133	- 導致 `h j k l` 等按鍵仍進入中文輸入狀態
134	
135	因此目前比較保守的結論是：
136	
137	- `vim_mode` 可以保留，因為在部分 app 或部分情境仍有幫助
138	- 但不要把它當成 Terminal / iTerm / TUI 場景的可靠保證
139	
140	## 已知限制與 upstream 狀態
141	
142	以下狀態都以 `2026-03-31` 查閱 GitHub 為準。
143	
144	### 1. 全局中英狀態目前仍無可靠官方解法
145	
146	- [`rime/home#202`](https://github.com/rime/home/issues/202) 仍為 open。這個 issue 自 `2017-12-24` 起就在問「全域統一中英切換」。
147	- [`rime/squirrel#145`](https://github.com/rime/squirrel/issues/145) 仍為 open。主題就是「是否有可能将中英文输入状态作全局管理？」
148	- [`rime/librime#294`](https://github.com/rime/librime/issues/294) 仍為 open。它把問題提升到 librime 層，直接討論是否要讓所有 client app 共用 global input session / state。
149	
150	綜合這幾個 issue，可以合理推論目前的限制不只是單一 app 設定問題，而是牽涉到 Squirrel 與 librime 的狀態模型。
151	
152	### 2. `global_ascii` 目前不能當成已正式可用功能
153	
154	- [`rime/squirrel#201`](https://github.com/rime/squirrel/pull/201) 是一個想把 `ascii_mode` 做成跨 app 全局狀態的舊 PR；截至 `2026-03-31` 已 closed，未合併
155	- [`rime/squirrel#1054`](https://github.com/rime/squirrel/pull/1054) 嘗試用 `global_ascii` 配置項處理這件事；截至 `2026-03-31` 也已 closed，且沒有 merged 標記
156	
157	本機安裝的 Squirrel `1.1.2` 內容裡也找不到 `global_ascii` 關鍵字，因此目前不應把 `global_ascii` 寫成已可依賴方案。
158	
159	### 3. 實務上的結論
160	
161	目前比較務實的策略是：
162	
163	- 用 `app_options` 管理每個 app 的「偏好初始狀態」
164	- 在終端與編輯器場景搭配 `no_inline: true`
165	- 視需要保留 `vim_mode: true`，但承認它在 Terminal 類 app 上不可靠
166	- 如果重點是「可見性」，用額外工具顯示當前輸入法狀態，而不是期待 Rime 已經解決全局同步
167	
168	## 狀態可見性工具
169	
170	[ShowyEdge](https://github.com/pqrs-org/ShowyEdge/) 的定位很清楚：它是 macOS 的「current input source 可視化指示器」。
171	
172	這類工具的價值在於：
173	
174	- 讓你一眼看出現在是 ABC、注音、拼音或其他輸入來源
175	- 降低 app / 視窗切換之後的狀態不確定感
176	
177	但它不是 Rime / Squirrel / librime 的全局狀態修復器。比較準確的期待應該是：
178	
179	- 它能改善觀測
180	- 不能保證改善切換行為本身
181	
182	## 備份策略
183	
184	這一輪的預設策略是：只備份「手寫設定」與「手動維護內容」，不把所有運行時產物都當成 source of truth。
185	
186	### Rime：建議備份
187	
188	優先備份：
189	
190	- `~/Library/Rime/*.custom.yaml`
191	- 目前最重要的是 `~/Library/Rime/squirrel.custom.yaml`
192	
193	如果之後開始客製 schema，也一併把這些視為手寫設定：
194	
195	- `~/Library/Rime/default.custom.yaml`
196	- `~/Library/Rime/bopomofo.custom.yaml`
197	- 其他 `<schema>.custom.yaml`
198	
199	### Rime：先不要直接納入 chezmoi 的內容
200	
201	以下檔案不建議直接當成 repo 內主要真相來源：
202	
203	- `~/Library/Rime/build/`
204	- `~/Library/Rime/installation.yaml`
205	- `~/Library/Rime/user.yaml`
206	- `~/Library/Rime/*.userdb/`
207	
208	原因：
209	
210	- `build/` 是重新佈署後的編譯產物
211	- `installation.yaml` 偏向機器與安裝資訊
212	- `user.yaml` 偏向運行狀態與最近使用方案
213	- `*.userdb/` 是 live user dictionary / frequency data，變動頻繁，直接納管很吵
214	
215	### Rime：`sync/` 的定位
216	
217	`~/Library/Rime/sync/<installation_id>/` 應該視為同步或匯出產物，不是主要 source of truth。
218	
219	它有兩個用途：
220	
221	- 跨機同步時，可作為 Rime 自己輸出的可攜資料
222	- 在需要救援或搬機時，可作為 userdb 快照與 custom 檔副本
223	
224	但 repo 策略上，仍建議以手寫的 `*.custom.yaml` 當主要真相來源，而不是以 `sync/` 內容反推設定。
225	
226	### McBopomofo：建議備份
227	
228	McBopomofo 官方手冊明確提到：
229	
230	- 使用者詞彙分頁管理的是純文字檔
231	- 這些文字檔位置可以自行決定
232	- 甚至可以放到 Google Drive / OneDrive / iCloud Drive 方便備份
233	
234	以本機目前狀態，建議優先備份：
235	
236	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/data.txt`
237	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/data-plain-bpmf.txt`
238	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/exclude-phrases.txt`
239	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/exclude-phrases-plain-bpmf.txt`
240	- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/phrases-replacement.txt`
241	
242	### McBopomofo：可選備份
243	
244	可選：
245	
246	- `~/Library/Preferences/org.openvanilla.inputmethod.McBopomofo.plist`
247	
248	理由：
249	
250	- 這裡主要是偏好設定與行為選項
251	- 對於詞庫與自訂詞本身不是唯一來源
252	- 如果目標是低噪音、可審查、適合版本控制，文字詞庫的優先級更高
253	
254	## 之後若要正式納入 chezmoi
255	
256	這一輪先不把輸入法資料正式納管進 repo，但如果下一輪要做，建議優先順序如下：
257	
258	1. `squirrel.custom.yaml`
259	2. 其他手寫的 Rime `*.custom.yaml`
260	3. McBopomofo 的 `*.txt` 詞庫檔
261	4. 最後才考慮是否要納入 McBopomofo 的 plist
262	
263	不建議一開始就把整個 `~/Library/Rime/` 或 `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/` 直接整包納入，因為會混入大量運行時資料。
264	
265	## Linux Appendix
266	
267	這裡只補最小必要資訊，不展開 Linux 端排障。
268	
269	### ibus-rime 配置目錄
270	
271	根據 Rime wiki，IBus 的使用者資料夾通常是：
272	
273	- `~/.config/ibus/rime/`
274	
275	舊版本可能還會看到：
276	
277	- `~/.ibus/rime/`
278	
279	### ibus-rime 重新部署
280	
281	根據 Rime wiki 的 `CustomizationGuide`，如果找不到狀態欄上的 deploy 按鈕，可在終端觸發：
282	
283	```bash
284	touch ~/.config/ibus/rime/
285	ibus restart
286	```
287	
288	如果未來這個 repo 要把 Linux 端 Rime 設定一起納管，建議也同樣只從 `*.custom.yaml` 開始，而不是直接處理整個資料夾。

```text
1	# macOS System-Level Input Source Switching
2	
3	整理目前在 macOS 上管理 input source 切換的幾種常見方案，重點是：
4	
5	- 不依賴 Rime / Squirrel 內建的 `app_options` 或 `vim_mode`
6	- 直接操作 macOS 的 input source layer
7	- 回答兩個實際問題：
8	  - 能不能維持「全局一致」？
9	  - 能不能做到「特定 app 預設輸入法」？
10	
11	查閱日期：`2026-03-31`
12	
13	## TL;DR
14	
15	### Apple 原生能做到什麼
16	
17	Apple 官方目前明確文件化的原生能力主要是：
18	
19	- 顯示 input menu
20	- 用 `Caps Lock` 在 non-Latin 與「last used Latin input source」間切換
21	- 用 `Fn` / `Globe` 或快捷鍵切換 input source
22	- 記住「每個文件」的 input source
23	
24	最重要的原生選項在：
25	
26	- `System Settings > Keyboard > Text Input > Edit > Automatically switch to a document's input source`
27	
28	Apple 的描述是：同一個文件在關閉前，會記住自己的 input source。  
29	所以如果目標是「盡量全局一致」，通常應先把這個選項關掉。
30	
31	### Apple 原生做不到什麼
32	
33	我沒有找到 Apple 官方文件化的「per-app 預設輸入法」功能。這裡的結論是根據目前 Apple 文件可見內容做的推論，不是 Apple 明文說「絕對不支援」。
34	
35	換句話說：
36	
37	- `全局一致`: Apple 原生可部分改善
38	- `特定 app 預設`: 目前看不到 Apple 原生正式支援
39	
40	## 方案總覽
41	
42	| 方案 | 操作層級 | 全局一致 | per-app 預設 | 備註 |
43	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
44	| Apple 原生設定 | 系統內建 | 部分可行 | 不明顯支援 | 先關閉 per-document 記憶 |
45	| Input Source Pro | 系統層 app 規則 | 可 | 可 | 成品最完整 |
46	| Hammerspoon | 系統層自動化 | 可 | 可 | 開源，可自訂規則 |
47	| Keyboard Maestro / BetterTouchTool | 系統層自動化 | 可 | 可 | 適合已有自動化棧的人 |
48	| `macism` | CLI backend | 不是完整方案 | 可被上層調用 | 適合搭 Hammerspoon / KM / BTT |
49	| `im-select` | CLI backend | 不是完整方案 | 可被上層調用 | macOS 上對 CJK 切換可靠性較弱 |
50	| Karabiner-Elements | 快捷鍵 / 改鍵 | 不擅長 | 不擅長 | 官方直接提醒 CJKV 可能失敗 |
51	
52	## 1. Apple 原生設定
53	
54	參考：
55	
56	- [Change Input Sources settings on Mac - Apple Support](https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/change-input-sources-settings-mchl84525d76/mac)
57	
58	Apple 目前明確列出的相關選項有：
59	
60	- `Show Input menu in menu bar`
61	- `Use the Caps Lock key to switch to and from [last used Latin input source]`
62	- `Automatically switch to a document's input source`
63	- `Fn` / `Globe` key 切換 input source
64	
65	### 適合的用法
66	
67	如果目標是減少狀態混亂，先做這兩件事：
68	
69	1. 關掉 `Automatically switch to a document's input source`
70	2. 開啟 menu bar input menu，保留可見性
71	
72	### 能力邊界
73	
74	- 可改善「切文件之後狀態突然不同」的情況
75	- 不能直接表達「Terminal 一律 ABC、WeChat 一律注音」這種 app rule
76	
77	所以原生設定比較像是：
78	
79	- 收斂全局行為
80	- 但不是 app-aware rule engine
81	
82	## 2. Input Source Pro
83	
84	參考：
85	
86	- [Input Source Pro 官網](https://inputsource.pro/)
87	- [Input Source Pro Changelog](https://inputsource.pro/changelog)
88	- [runjuu/InputSourcePro](https://github.com/runjuu/InputSourcePro)
89	
90	這是目前最接近「現成可用 app 規則系統」的方案。
91	
92	官網明列能力：
93	
94	- 根據 app 自動切換 input source
95	- 根據網站自動切換 input source
96	- 顯示目前 input source
97	- 在 IDE / Terminal 類 app 強制英文標點
98	
99	截至 `2026-01-18` 的 `2.9.0` changelog 也還在持續改善 switching logic consistency。
100	
101	### 優點
102	
103	- 成品完整，不需要自己寫 watcher
104	- 明確支援 per-app 預設
105	- 還有可見性與標點規則
106	
107	### 缺點
108	
109	- 不是系統內建
110	- 如果你想把規則版本化進 dotfiles，不如 Hammerspoon 直觀
111	
112	### 適合誰
113	
114	- 想最快得到「app 切換時自動切輸入法」
115	- 不想自己維護 Lua / AppleScript / shell glue
116	
117	## 3. Hammerspoon
118	
119	參考：
120	
121	- [InputSourceSwitch Spoon](https://www.hammerspoon.org/Spoons/InputSourceSwitch.html)
122	- [hs.keycodes](https://www.hammerspoon.org/docs/hs.keycodes.html)
123	
124	Hammerspoon 是最適合做「自己掌控規則，但又保持在 macOS input source layer」的開源方案。
125	
126	官方現成 Spoon `InputSourceSwitch` 已直接支援：
127	
128	- 切 app 時自動切換 input source
129	
130	範例就是：
131	
132	```lua
133	hs.loadSpoon("InputSourceSwitch")
134	spoon.InputSourceSwitch:setApplications({
135	  ["WeChat"] = "Pinyin - Simplified",
136	  ["Mail"] = "ABC",
137	})
138	spoon.InputSourceSwitch:start()
139	```
140	
141	如果不想只靠 Spoon，也可以自己用 `hs.keycodes.currentSourceID([sourceID])` 讀寫目前的 input source，自己綁 app watcher 或 window watcher。
142	
143	### 優點
144	
145	- 開源
146	- 規則可版本控制
147	- 可以做得很細，例如：
148	  - app activated 時切換
149	  - 只對某些視窗標題切換
150	  - 額外加 menubar / alert 指示
151	
152	### 缺點
153	
154	- 要自己維護設定
155	- 如果底層切換本身遇到 macOS/CJK 問題，仍可能需要更可靠的 CLI backend
156	
157	## 4. Keyboard Maestro / BetterTouchTool
158	
159	參考：
160	
161	- [Keyboard Maestro Application Trigger](https://wiki.keyboardmaestro.com/trigger/Application)
162	- [Keyboard Maestro Execute a Shell Script](https://wiki.keyboardmaestro.com/action/Execute_a_Shell_Script)
163	- [BetterTouchTool Global and App-Specific Triggers](https://docs.folivora.ai/docs/configuration/global-vs-app-specific/)
164	
165	這兩者都不是專用 input source 工具，但都能做出「app activated -> 執行 script -> 切輸入法」的流程。
166	
167	### Keyboard Maestro
168	
169	Keyboard Maestro 官方文件明確支援：
170	
171	- application activates / deactivates trigger
172	- Execute a Shell Script action
173	
174	所以可以做：
175	
176	1. App Activate Trigger
177	2. 呼叫 `macism` 或其他 CLI
178	3. 切到指定 input source
179	
180	### BetterTouchTool
181	
182	BetterTouchTool 官方文件明確支援：
183	
184	- global triggers
185	- app-specific triggers
186	- conditional activation groups
187	
188	它本身不是專門的 input source 切換器，但如果你本來就有 BTT，自動化入口已經足夠，只差底層切換命令。
189	
190	### 什麼時候選這條路
191	
192	- 你本來就在用 KM / BTT
193	- 想把輸入法切換跟其他 workspace automation 合併
194	- 不想再引入一套新的整體框架
195	
196	## 5. CLI backend：`macism` 與 `im-select`
197	
198	這兩個通常不是完整解法，而是給上層工具調用的切換 backend。
199	
200	### `macism`
201	
202	參考：
203	
204	- [laishulu/macism](https://github.com/laishulu/macism)
205	
206	`macism` README 的核心主張是：
207	
208	- 它比 `im-select` 等類似工具更可靠地切換 CJKV input source
209	- 其他工具有時會出現 menu bar icon 已變，但實際輸入來源沒真的切過去的情況
210	
211	這個專案也直接提供：
212	
213	- 取得目前 input source
214	- 設定指定 input source
215	- 內建 workaround for the macOS bug
216	
217	如果你要自己用 Hammerspoon / Keyboard Maestro / BetterTouchTool 拼裝，我會優先考慮 `macism`。
218	
219	### `im-select`
220	
221	參考：
222	
223	- [daipeihust/im-select](https://github.com/daipeihust/im-select)
224	
225	`im-select` 是常見方案，很多 Vim / VSCodeVim 設定都支援它。
226	
227	但如果你的核心場景是：
228	
229	- 中文 / 日文 / 韓文 / 越南文等 CJKV input source
230	- 要求切換後立即可靠生效
231	
232	那目前資料更偏向：
233	
234	- `im-select` 可用
235	- 但 macOS 上 CJK 切換可靠性通常不如 `macism`
236	
237	## 6. Karabiner-Elements
238	
239	參考：
240	
241	- [to.select_input_source](https://karabiner-elements.pqrs.org/docs/json/complex-modifications-manipulator-definition/to/select-input-source/)
242	
243	Karabiner 很適合做：
244	
245	- 快捷鍵綁定
246	- 依 input source 條件改鍵
247	- 送出切換快捷鍵
248	
249	但不適合當這題的主方案。
250	
251	Karabiner 官方文件直接提醒：
252	
253	- 對有 `input_mode_id` 的輸入法，例如 CJKV，`select_input_source` 可能因 macOS 問題失敗
254	- 對 CJKV，官方甚至建議送出 input source switch shortcut，例如 `control-space`
255	
256	所以它比較適合：
257	
258	- 做 hotkey
259	- 做狀態條件
260	- 當輔助層
261	
262	而不是當主要的 per-app input source manager。
263	
264	## 推薦路線
265	
266	### 路線 A：最少折騰
267	
268	適合先驗證問題是不是主要來自 macOS 的 per-document 行為。
269	
270	1. 關掉 `Automatically switch to a document's input source`
271	2. 保留 menu bar input menu 或其他 indicator
272	3. 先觀察是否已經大幅減少混亂
273	
274	### 路線 B：想要每個 app 自動切到指定輸入法
275	
276	首選：
277	
278	- Input Source Pro
279	
280	原因：
281	
282	- 這是目前最完整的成品
283	- 有 app rules
284	- 有 indicator
285	- 有 terminal / IDE 標點類附加功能
286	
287	### 路線 C：想要開源、可版本控制、可放進 dotfiles
288	
289	首選：
290	
291	- Hammerspoon + `macism`
292	
293	原因：
294	
295	- Hammerspoon 負責 watcher / 規則
296	- `macism` 負責較可靠的底層切換
297	- 最適合 repo 化與長期維護
298	
299	### 路線 D：你本來就重度使用 KM / BTT
300	
301	首選：
302	
303	- Keyboard Maestro / BetterTouchTool + `macism`
304	
305	原因：
306	
307	- 不需要再多引入一套自動化邏輯
308	- 直接掛在既有 app activate trigger 上
309	
310	## 與 Rime / Squirrel 的關係
311	
312	這些方案的共同點是：
313	
314	- 目標是從 macOS input source layer 管理切換
315	- 不依賴 Squirrel 的 `app_options` 或 `vim_mode`
316	
317	因此比較適合處理：
318	
319	- app 切換時想要固定英文 / 固定中文
320	- 想降低「現在到底是什麼輸入狀態」的不確定感
321	
322	但要注意：
323	
324	- 如果底層 macOS 對某些 CJK input source 本身就有切換 bug，任何方案都可能只是在不同程度上繞過它
325	- 所以實務上，`system automation layer + visible indicator` 往往比只追求「自動切換」更穩
326	
327	## References
328

 `https://github.com/rime/home/wiki/CustomizationGuide`

```text
Below is a concise reference of user-editable Rime config files, their roles, portability (which platform uses which file), user-folder locations, a short note on the patch / __patch behavior, and how redeploy (“重新佈署”) is done. I only use short quoted fragments (≤125 chars) taken from the source where indicated.

Files you can edit (user-level) and what they control
- default.custom.yaml
  - Global overrides for defaults (UI, schema list, hotkeys, recognizers, etc.). Use to change system-wide settings such as the scheme list, global hotkeys, recognizer patterns, style defaults, etc.
  - Example quoted key used as the entrypoint to patches: "patch:".

- <schema>.custom.yaml (e.g., luna_pinyin.custom.yaml, cangjie5.custom.yaml, wubi86.custom.yaml)
  - Scheme-specific overrides. Modify behavior of one input scheme: speller rules, switches, engine.filters, translator options, key bindings, punctuation mappings, simplifier settings, etc.
  - Use when you want a change to affect only one schema.

- weasel.custom.yaml
  - Visual and behavior customization for the Weasel front end (小狼毫). Controls style/font/color scheme, tray icon, inline preedit, horizontal candidate bar, app-specific options for Weasel, and key bindings when using Weasel.

- squirrel.custom.yaml
  - Visual and per-app settings for Squirrel (鼠鬚管, macOS). Use for Squirrel-specific color/font and app_options (per-app initial ascii_mode etc).

- ibus_rime.custom.yaml
  - For ibus-rime (Linux) front end users: contains user customizations relevant to ibus backend (note: it "does not include" some visual style keys per doc).

- user.yaml
  - Per-user persistent settings (personal profile, preferences stored by Rime). Typically holds user-specific settings not covered by the .custom files (user dictionary behavior, last states). (Document references user dictionary / settings elsewhere; keep edits minimal.)

- installation.yaml
  - Generated at install; records installation/build metadata. Useful for diagnostics and identifying installed package versions; do not typically edit manually.

- build/ directory (inside user folder)
  - Build artifacts for compiled schemas and dictionaries. When you change schema sources or custom files, Rime rebuilds files here. You can inspect it for generated schema files and logs.

- *.userdb (user dictionaries; directories or files)
  - Per-user databases storing learned phrases / user dictionary contents and frequency adjustments. Editing can affect candidate ordering and learning memory.

Portability / platform specificity
- Portable across platforms (conceptually): default.custom.yaml and <schema>.custom.yaml are portable YAML patches that apply to all front ends; the patch semantics are the same cross-platform. Schema-level custom files travel with your user folder and will be used by any front end if present.
- Platform-specific files:
  - weasel.custom.yaml — used by Weasel front end (Windows and some Windows/mac Weasel builds). Platform-specific UI keys (font names, tray behavior) may differ.
  - squirrel.custom.yaml — used by Squirrel (macOS). Contains macOS-specific app options (Bundle Identifiers, TSF support notes).
  - ibus_rime.custom.yaml — used with ibus-rime (Linux). It is specific to the ibus integration.
  - Some keys (e.g., TSF-only inline_preedit) only have effect on platforms/front ends that support the feature.

User folder locations (where to save those files)
- Linux (ibus-rime, generic): ~/.config/ibus/rime
  - Example command in doc for triggering redeploy (Linux/ibus): "touch ~/.config/ibus/rime/; ibus restart"
- macOS (Squirrel): ~/Library/Rime
- Windows (Weasel): %APPDATA%\Rime

Patch syntax basics (how to write a custom file)
- Top-level entry is a mapping under the literal key patch:. Quote from the doc (entry key): "patch:"
- Behavior (paraphrased):
  - The .custom.yaml file supplies a "patch" map whose keys are paths into the source YAML tree (slash-separated), and values are the new values to set or merge.
  - For list elements you can target positions using special suffixes: /@n (nth element, 0-based), /@last (last element), /@before 0 or /@after last (insert), /+ to merge lists, and /+ to merge dictionaries. These let you replace, insert, or merge items rather than rewriting the entire structure.
  - For complex schema edits there is also a special "__patch" list form (used in some schema speller/algebra patches) that inserts or composes entries into existing lists. (The doc shows use of __patch to insert algebra rules.)
  - When replacing a whole list (e.g., schema_list) you normally provide the full list under the path (the doc example replaces schema_list entirely).

Redeploy (重新佈署) — how edits take effect
- You must redeploy to apply edits. Short quoted label used by GUIs: "重新佈署".
- How to trigger:
  - Weasel (Windows/Weasel front end): use the tray/menu "重新佈署" item, or the Weasel start menu → 小狼毫輸入法 → 重新佈署. If tray icon is shown, right-click → Redeploy.
  - Squirrel (macOS): choose Redeploy from the system language/input menu.
  - ibus (Linux): run the provided command to trigger redeploy and restart ibus: "touch ~/.config/ibus/rime/; ibus restart"
- Notes:
  - Changes only take effect after redeploy. Building new schemes can take time; temporarily you may not be able to output Chinese until the build finishes.
  - If a schema menu appears but the scheme fails to operate, check the logs (the doc advises looking at log files).

Small practical tips pulled from examples (paraphrased)
- To set per-page candidate size globally: add patch: "menu/page_size": 9 to default.custom.yaml.
- To override punctuation for a schema: in <schema>.custom.yaml set punctuator/full_shape and punctuator/half_shape paths to the desired mappings.
- To set a schema’s switches or default simplifier behavior, modify switches under that schema’s .custom.yaml (e.g., set reset: 1 for simplification to default to simplified output).
- To add or reorder enabled schemas shown in the scheme menu, replace schema_list in default.custom.yaml with your desired list.

Quoted fragments used (each ≤125 chars)
- "patch:"
- "touch ~/.config/ibus/rime/; ibus restart"
- "重新佈署"

If you want, I can:
- produce ready-to-drop-in example .custom.yaml snippets for a specific platform and goal (e.g., default simplified output, add wubi schema, set hotkey), or
- summarize which exact keys are ignored by a front end you use (Weasel vs Squirrel vs ibus) if you tell me which front end and OS you use.
```

I searched the web for the Rime user/config folder locations and for advice about sharing/symlinking the config. Short summary of the findings and practical notes:

Default user (per‑user) Rime config locations
- Windows (Weasel): %APPDATA%\Rime. You can open the “User folder” from the Weasel menu; user data (config, user dictionaries) live under %AppData%\Rime. ([github.com](https://github.com/nantianliao/rime-weasel))  
- macOS (Squirrel): ~/Library/Rime. macOS Squirrel expects the user directory in that Library path. ([github.com](https://github.com/gkovacs/squirrel-rime-config))  
- Linux (ibus-rime): ~/.config/ibus/rime. (If you use Fcitx5, the corresponding path is typically ~/.local/share/fcitx5/rime.) ([mintimate.cc](https://mintimate.cc/en/guide/importMint.html))

Notes about sharing configs (symlink / cloud sync)
- Rime tools and install scripts are symlink-aware and many community guides assume you can place your config in a shared location and point the per‑user folder at it. (The rime/plum install scripts explicitly follow symlinks if present.) ([github.com](https://github.com/rime/plum/blob/master/rime-install))  
- macOS / Linux (example): remove or rename the original user folder, then create a symlink from the expected location to your shared/config location:
  - macOS: ln -s /path/to/shared/Rime ~/Library/Rime  
  - Linux (ibus): ln -s /path/to/shared/Rime ~/.config/ibus/rime  
  (After linking, restart the input method and redeploy if necessary.) ([blog.bdim.moe](https://blog.bdim.moe/posts/configuring-rime-input-method-on-macos/))
- Windows: use mklink (or a directory junction) to point %APPDATA%\Rime to your shared folder. Example (run in an elevated or Developer Mode prompt):
  - Junction (no admin sometimes required): mklink /J "%APPDATA%\Rime" "D:\path\to\shared\Rime"
  - Directory symbolic link: mklink /D "%APPDATA%\Rime" "D:\path\to\shared\Rime"
  See Windows docs / how‑to guides for mklink, and prefer junctions for compatibility if you only need directory redirection. ([howtogeek.com](https://www.howtogeek.com/16226/complete-guide-to-symbolic-links-symlinks-on-windows-or-linux/))

Caveats and practical tips
- Symlinks break if the target is moved/renamed; be careful when switching storage locations. Back up original configs before making changes. ([2brightsparks.com](https://www.2brightsparks.com/resources/articles/ntfs-hard-links-junctions-and-symbolic-links.html))  
- Client differences: if you use different frontends across OSes (Weasel, Squirrel, ibus‑rime, fcitx5), double‑check frontend‑specific locations and whether the frontend expects any additional per‑machine files (some frontends store logs or runtime files elsewhere). ([rime.im](https://rime.im/code/))  
- Many users prefer syncing the user folder via cloud (Dropbox/iCloud/OneDrive) and using a symlink to the synced folder so each OS still finds the expected path. Rime community guides and "oh‑my‑rime" installers describe these workflows. ([deepwiki.com](https://deepwiki.com/ssnhd/rime/2.4-synchronization-system))

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) and other coding

5	
6	## What this is
7	
8	Standalone, **Windows-only** dotfiles managed by [chezmoi](https://chezmoi.io),
9	targeting **PowerShell 7 (pwsh)**. It is a companion to the cross-platform
10	macOS/Linux repo `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` — the PowerShell layer is written
11	natively, **not** ported from that repo's POSIX shell config. No ansible;
12	packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI). Published at
13	`github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows`.
14	
15	**Dev box vs target:** the deploy target is Windows, but this checkout is usually
16	edited on macOS/Linux. You therefore **cannot execute the `.ps1` run-scripts
17	here** (they call winget / `%APPDATA%`). Validate with the isolated-apply +
18	render/parse pattern below; the `windows-latest` CI is the real gate.
19	
20	## Commands
21	
22	Real machine:
23	
24	- `chezmoi apply` / `chezmoi diff` (or `just apply` / `just diff`)
25	- `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`
26	
27	Validate locally (needs a local pwsh, e.g. installed to `~/.local/bin/pwsh`):
28	
29	- Lint: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Settings ./PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1"` (fails only on Error; the excludes are deliberate — see the settings file header)
30	- Tests: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests"` (single file: `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/Copilot.Tests.ps1`)
31	- Docs: `just docs-build` (= `uv run --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-static-i18n mkdocs build --strict`)
32	
33	Isolated apply + template render (the core idiom for testing without a Windows
34	box — all chezmoi state is redirected to a temp dir, so it never touches your
35	real setup):
36	
37	```bash
38	TMPD=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$TMPD/home"
39	chezmoi init --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
40	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --no-tty \
41	  --promptChoice='Role: workstation (full desktop) or minimal (shell only)=minimal' \
42	  --promptString='Your full name (git)=T' --promptString='Your git email=t@e.com' ...  # EVERY prompt, exact text
43	chezmoi apply --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
44	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --exclude=scripts   # scripts can't run off-Windows
45	chezmoi execute-template --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --source="$PWD" < some.ps1.tmpl > r.ps1  # then parse r.ps1 with pwsh
46	```
47	
48	## Architecture (big picture)
49	
50	- **Init** — `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` `[data]` prompts once (`role` → coarse defaults, then `installX` toggles) and sets `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh` so chezmoi runs `.ps1` scripts under pwsh. Prompts are hand-authored here (the parent repo generates them; this repo does not).
51	- **Shell** — `Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1` is a thin `$PROFILE` loader that dot-sources `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in numeric order (env → tool activation → aliases → apps/audio/clipboard → copilot import → yazi → tv cache → psreadline). Add a shell feature = a new numbered fragment. User overrides go in the untracked `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1`.
52	- **Packages** — `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the single source of truth for installs: scoop (CLI), winget (GUI), npm (AI agents), PSGallery (PSFzf / AudioDeviceCmdlets), all gated by init toggles. Fault-tolerant (see invariants).
53	- **copilot-proxy** — `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/` is a native PowerShell port of the parent's `43_copilot_proxy.sh` / `44_copilot_embed.sh` (runs the copilot-api fork so GitHub Copilot can back Claude Code). Reuses the Bun `copilot-throttle-shim.js` verbatim.
54	- **Config surfaces** — Alacritty (`AppData/Roaming/alacritty/`), Windows Terminal (a run_onchange that merges `profiles.defaults` non-destructively), WezTerm (`dot_config/wezterm/wezterm.lua` — sets pwsh as `default_prog`), editors (a run_onchange that deep-merges `editors/*.json` into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`), Claude Code (a run_onchange that recursively deep-merges `claude/settings-overlay.json` — claude-hud statusline, safe defaults, and **additive** `Notification`/`Stop` notify hooks — into `~/.claude/settings.json` non-destructively, gated on `installCodingAgents`), apprise desktop notifications (`dot_config/apprise/apprise.yaml` → `~/.config/apprise/`; the `windows://` toast backend behind the Claude notify hook `dot_claude/hooks/notify.ps1`, `installCodingAgents`-gated — the notify hook and peon-ping's voice-line hooks are both gated on the `agentSounds` tier (none|notify|peon|both) and built in the run_onchange, NOT in `claude/settings-overlay.json`; see docs/agent-sounds.md), television channels (`AppData/Roaming/television/`), starship + yazi (`~/.config`, yazi via `YAZI_CONFIG_HOME`), herdr (see below).
55	- **herdr** — `dot_config/herdr/` is deployed via `HERDR_CONFIG_PATH` and gated on `installHerdr`. `config.toml` is a **`modify_` overlay** (`modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` + `.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml`), never a plain managed file: herdr rewrites that file at runtime (onboarding flag, `[session]`, `[remote]`, `[update]` bookkeeping) and a plain file clobbers it. The overlay enforces `[theme]`/`[ui]`/`[terminal]`/`[keys]` wholesale, pulls every other top-level key through, and re-asserts the single key `update.channel = "preview"` (the Windows installer rejects `stable`). Helper-script paths in the keymap are baked **absolute at render time** — `pwsh -File` does not expand `~`. Six pwsh helpers (`_common.ps1` + run-command / new-tab-at-space-root / url-pick / path-pick / pane-copy / review-mark) back the `[[keys.command]]` bindings; three `herdr-*` tv channels and the herdr-plus quick-actions are gated by the same toggle. Ported from the parent repo 2026-07-27; the behaviours that still need a real Windows box are listed in [`backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md`](backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md).
56	- **Docs** — bilingual mkdocs-material (`docs/X.md` + `docs/X.zh-TW.md`), deployed to GitHub Pages by `.github/workflows/docs.yml`. `docs/rationale.md` records the design choices (scoop > Chocolatey, starship > oh-my-posh, pwsh > cmd, native pwsh tree > ported shell layer).
57	- **CI** — `.github/workflows/windows.yml` on `windows-latest` is the real gate: PSScriptAnalyzer, non-interactive `chezmoi init --apply`, render+parse of every `.ps1.tmpl`, and Pester.
58	
59	## Conventions & hard invariants
60	
61	1. **A new/renamed init prompt must update the CI flags in the same commit.** `chezmoi init --promptBool/--promptChoice "<text>=value"` matches the prompt's exact TEXT (3rd arg to `promptXOnce` in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`), used non-interactively by `.github/workflows/windows.yml`. Forget it → CI's init hangs/EOFs (`error calling promptChoiceOnce: EOF`; this broke three consecutive pushes when `agentSounds` was added). Corollary: **never put `=` in a prompt's text** — the `name=value` parser splits on the first `=` (this broke the `role` prompt once). Enforced by `tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` (missing flag, stale flag, wrong flag kind, `=` in text), which CI runs *before* `chezmoi init` so the failure names the missing flag instead of EOF-ing — run `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` locally after touching either file.
62	2. **Run-scripts must never abort the apply.** The installer + editor/terminal/backup/skill scripts use `$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'` (+ `PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=$false`), collect failures via `Register-Failure`, print a summary, and exit 0. One bad scoop/winget manifest (e.g. btop's stale `.conf`) must not stop the rest.
63	3. **Preserve raw escapes when authoring config with control chars.** Alacritty CSI-u (`[…u`), VSCode `sendSequence`, tv `\t` — hand-typing tends to drop them. Generate via a throwaway Python script and re-parse (`tomllib` / `json`) to confirm the escape landed.
64	4. **tv channel commands are `pwsh -NoProfile -Command "…"` inside TOML literal (`'''…'''`) strings** — runs regardless of tv's shell, sidesteps nested-quote escaping; placeholders `{split: :0}` (space) / `{split:\t:0}` (tab). tv reads config from `%APPDATA%\television\` on Windows.
65	5. **Editors use a run_onchange pwsh merger, not `modify_`** (`modify_` interpreter selection is unreliable on Windows). Overlay sources live in `editors/` (chezmoi-ignored, embedded via `{{ include }}`).
66	6. **The agent skill body lives once** in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`; both `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` and `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` render it via `{{ "{{" }} template … {{ "}}" }}` → real files at `~/.agents/skills/` and `~/.claude/skills/`. Edit the shared template, not the two one-line renderers (no symlink/junction — those need elevation/Developer Mode on Windows).
67	7. **PSScriptAnalyzer exclusions are intentional** (`PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1`): hyphenated command names, `Write-Host`, `Invoke-Expression` for tool init, no-BOM UTF-8. Don't "fix" these; do fix real Errors.
68	
69	### Cross-file mirrors (same commit)
70	
71	- New installer tool → `docs/tools.md` **and** `docs/tools.zh-TW.md`.
72	- New init prompt → `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` + `windows.yml` flags + `docs/setup.md`/`setup.zh-TW.md` tables + the "What's enabled" block in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.
73	- New `docs/**/*.md` → its `.zh-TW.md` twin + `nav` + `nav_translations` in `mkdocs.yml`; `just docs-build` must stay green.

80	### Long-term backlog → `TODO.md` + `backlog/`
81	
82	When the user surfaces an idea explicitly **not** being implemented this
83	session (signals: "maybe later", "nice to have", "if I'm interested",
84	"工程量太大需要再評估", "先記下來"), add an entry to [`TODO.md`](TODO.md) using
85	the priority + effort tag schema. Do **not** create new `ROADMAP.md` /
86	`IDEAS.md` / `BACKLOG.md` files — `TODO.md` is the single index.
87	
88	The bundled `scripts/todo-kanban.sh` validates the format. Run it
89	(`scripts/todo-kanban.sh --validate-only TODO.md`) after editing so syntax
90	drift is caught immediately.
91	
92	#### Three ways to add a TODO entry (preferred order)
93	
94	1. **Structured CLI — `scripts/add-todo.sh`** (default):
95	
96	   ```
97	   scripts/add-todo.sh --priority P3 --effort M \
98	     --title "Title" --description "Description"
99	   ```
100	
101	   Inserts a canonically-formatted line into the right `## P*` lane and
102	   re-runs the validator. Add `--backlog` to also scaffold
103	   `backlog/<slug>.md` from the bundled template.
104	
105	2. **Quick capture — `backlog/inbox.md`** (when priority/effort unclear):
106	
107	   ```
108	   echo "- maybe add docs versioning with mike" >> backlog/inbox.md
109	   ```
110	
111	   When the user asks "sweep the inbox", run
112	   `scripts/sweep-inbox.sh`. It prompts for the missing fields per loose
113	   line and calls `add-todo.sh`. Use `--batch` for non-interactive runs
114	   that only formalize lines with parseable `key=value` pairs.
115	
116	3. **Direct edit of `TODO.md`** — fine if the format is fresh; run
117	   `scripts/todo-kanban.sh --validate-only` afterwards.
118	
119	Add a `backlog/<slug>.md` companion doc when the item meets any of:
120	
121	- carries a `P?` tag (record what was tried so it doesn't need re-investigation)
122	- captures a paused troubleshooting session that you intend to fix later
123	  (preserve the error trace + root cause analysis before context evaporates)
124	- weighs multiple options (record trade-offs, not only the winner)
125	- is `[L]` or `[XL]` (architectural; needs design before code)
126	
127	`[S]` items rarely need a backlog doc — a file path in the `TODO.md` line is
128	usually enough. See [`backlog/README.md`](backlog/README.md) for the full
129	template and "when to add a doc" rules.
130

138	
139	`backlog/` is excluded from chezmoi (see .chezmoiignore); it

141	
142	### Past pitfalls → `pitfalls/`
143	
144	When you spend more than ~15 minutes debugging something that wasn't
145	googleable and the fix is non-obvious, write a `pitfalls/<slug>.md`
146	capturing:

152	4. **Prevention** — how to avoid stepping on this again
153	
154	Title the doc by the **symptom**, not the root cause (you'll search by what
155	you're seeing, not by what you eventually learned). See
156	[`pitfalls/README.md`](pitfalls/README.md) for the full template and

159	**Pitfall vs Hard invariant**: a pitfall *graduates* to a Hard invariant in

```text
1	# Setup
2	
3	## One-line install
4	
5	From a fresh Windows PowerShell (or PowerShell 7) session:
6	
7	```powershell
8	irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows/main/bootstrap.ps1 | iex
9	```
10	
11	Or from **cmd.exe** — there's no native-cmd bootstrap to maintain; you hand off to
12	the in-box **Windows PowerShell (5.1)**, present on every Windows machine. Start
13	it, then run the one-liner interactively:
14	
15	```bat
16	powershell
17	```
18	```powershell
19	irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows/main/bootstrap.ps1 | iex
20	```
21	
22	Or download the script, read it, and run the **file** (safer — and it sidesteps
23	the Defender warning below):
24	
25	```bat
26	powershell -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows/main/bootstrap.ps1 -OutFile $env:TEMP\bootstrap.ps1"
27	notepad "%TEMP%\bootstrap.ps1"
28	powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%TEMP%\bootstrap.ps1"
29	```
30	
31	Use `powershell`, **not** `pwsh` — pwsh isn't installed yet on a fresh box. The
32	bootstrap logic lives once, in PowerShell (`bootstrap.ps1`): cmd is a poor
33	language for the elevation / `PATH` / `chezmoi` steps, and these dotfiles are
34	PowerShell anyway, so a machine with *no* PowerShell couldn't use the repo.
35	
36	!!! warning "Defender may flag the cmd irm|iex one-liner as ClickFix"
37	    Wrapping the cradle on a cmd command line —
38	    `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm <url> | iex"` — can trip
39	    Defender's **`Trojan:Win32/ClickFix.*!ml`** machine-learning heuristic. It's a
40	    **false positive on the command-line _shape_**, not our script (a content scan
41	    is clean): a `powershell` process whose command line is a remote
42	    download-cradle (`irm|iex`) plus `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` / `-NoProfile` is
43	    exactly the shape the
44	    [ClickFix](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2025/08/21/think-before-you-clickfix-analyzing-the-clickfix-social-engineering-technique/)
45	    fake-CAPTCHA campaigns use. The two forms above avoid it — the cradle never
46	    lands on a process command line, or you run a file instead — and inside an
47	    already-open PowerShell the one-liner is fine. Bigger lesson: **never paste a
48	    `powershell -c "irm|iex"` handed to you by a web page or a "verify you're
49	    human" prompt — that request _is_ the attack.**
50	
51	`bootstrap.ps1` does the following, idempotently:
52	
53	1. Sets the execution policy to `RemoteSigned` for the current user.
54	2. Installs [scoop](https://scoop.sh) (user-scoped, no admin — but if the shell
55	   is already elevated it auto-passes `-RunAsAdmin`, which the installer
56	   otherwise refuses with *"Running the installer as administrator is disabled
57	   by default"*).
58	3. Installs `git`, PowerShell 7 (`pwsh`), `chezmoi`, and `uv` via scoop.
59	4. Refreshes `PATH` from the registry so the just-installed scoop shims
60	   (`chezmoi`, `pwsh`, `uv`) resolve in the same session.
61	5. Runs `chezmoi init --apply` (or `chezmoi update` if the source is already
62	   cloned) — chezmoi runs the repo's `.ps1` scripts under pwsh itself
63	   (`[interpreters.ps1]`), so it never relaunches the shell. Works from Windows
64	   PowerShell 5.1 or pwsh 7.
65	
66	!!! warning "Behind the GFW"
67	    Keep a VPN on for the bootstrap — scoop downloads git / pwsh / chezmoi / uv
68	    from **GitHub releases**. The `China mirrors` option only redirects
69	    pip / npm / cargo / go / node at runtime, **not** scoop's own downloads.
70	
71	## Init prompts
72	
73	`chezmoi init` asks a few questions once (answers are stored and never re-asked):
74	
75	| Prompt | Default | Meaning |
76	|---|---|---|
77	| Role | `workstation` | `workstation` = full desktop; `minimal` = shell only |
78	| Coding agents | on (workstation) | Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Copilot CLI, SpecStory |
79	| Agent completion feedback | `notify` (workstation) / `none` (minimal) | what a coding agent does when it finishes: `none` / `notify` (Windows toast) / `peon` (game voice line) / `both` — see [Agent completion sounds](agent-sounds.md) |
80	| SpecStory build | off | build the experimental SpecStory CLI for Windows from the unmerged PR #191 (needs git + go) |
81	| Windows GUI apps | on (workstation) | VSCode, Cursor, Notepad++, Terminal, Alacritty, PowerToys, Raycast, Docker Desktop, Discord |
82	| WSL2 backend | on (workstation) | WSL2 for Docker Desktop's backend; self-elevates (one UAC prompt), reboot required |
83	| WSL2 Ubuntu | off | install a WSL2 Ubuntu distro + bootstrap cross-platform dotfiles (needs `installWsl`) |
84	| WSL Ubuntu username | your Windows user | UNIX login for the WSL Ubuntu (passwordless sudo, auto-login) |
85	| WSL Ubuntu bootstrap | `headless` | dotfiles install mode: `headless` (frozen from Windows) / `interactive` / `none` |
86	| Utility apps | on (workstation) | CPU-Z, GPU-Z, TreeSize, VLC, Everything, ShareX, HWiNFO |
87	| Gaming apps | off | Steam |
88	| Extra runtimes | on (workstation) | rust, go, ruby via mise (node/bun/uv are baseline) |
89	| Media CLIs | off | ffmpeg, imagemagick |
90	| Local LLM tools | off | Ollama, LiteLLM |
91	| Tunnel tools | off | ngrok, cloudflared |
92	| IaC tools | off | Azure CLI, Terraform, OpenTofu |
93	| OpenSSH server | off | install + enable sshd (needs admin; opens inbound TCP 22) |
94	| herdr multiplexer | off | native Windows terminal multiplexer (preview beta) |
95	| Clink (cmd.exe) | off | starship + zoxide + fzf in `cmd.exe` via Clink (opt-in secondary shell) |
96	| try (ephemeral workspaces) | off | Ruby CLI (`gem try-cli`): dated trial dirs + fuzzy selector; pwsh command is `tri` |
97	| translate | on (workstation) | terminal translator CLI + TUI, built from source with `go install` (first build takes minutes) |
98	| China mirrors | off | pip / npm / cargo / go / node via GFW mirrors |
99	| Managed machine | off | skip apps org policy usually blocks (Tailscale, Grammarly) |
100	| Backup mode | `smart` | snapshot existing files before the first apply (`smart`/`full`/`off`) |
101	| PSReadLine vi mode | on | vi editing in the shell |
102	
103	Re-run the prompts later with `chezmoi init` again, or edit
104	`%USERPROFILE%\.config\chezmoi\chezmoi.toml`.
105	
106	## Day-to-day
107	
108	```powershell
109	chezmoi diff            # preview pending changes
110	chezmoi apply           # apply local source edits only (no pull)
111	chezmoi update --init   # git pull + apply; --init re-asks any newly-added prompts (noop if none)
112	just upgrade-scoop     # upgrade CLI tools
113	just upgrade-winget    # upgrade GUI apps
114	```
115	
116	Inside a loaded pwsh session, `cau` (= `chezmoi update --init` + reload
117	`$PROFILE`) and `cas` (= `chezmoi apply` + reload) are the shortcuts. Prefer
118	`cau` as the normal "sync my dotfiles" verb — `--init` means a machine that's
119	behind on newly-added init prompts gets asked them on the next pull.
120	
121	## Local overrides
122	
123	Drop machine-specific tweaks or secrets in
124	`~/.config/powershell/local.ps1` — it is dot-sourced last by `$PROFILE` and is
125	never managed by chezmoi.
126	
127	## The Raycast / PowerToys clash
128	
129	Raycast and PowerToys Run both default their launcher to **Alt+Space**. Pick one:
130	disable PowerToys Run (PowerToys Settings → PowerToys Run → off) or rebind its
131	hotkey. The installer prints a reminder.
132

15	- Preview / apply: `chezmoi diff` / `chezmoi apply` (or `just diff` / `just apply`).

20	## Shell layout (pwsh)

22	  that dot-sources `~/.config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in sorted order, then

32	  truth** for installs, gated by the init toggles. scoop = CLI tools, winget = GUI

39	- Module at `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`. Commands: `copilot-proxy`
40	  (`start`/`stop`/`restart`/`status`/`doctor`/`logs`/`shim`/`whoami`/`auth`/`reinstall`),

1	#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
2	# chezmoi modify_ script: overlay a managed herdr config onto ~/.config/herdr/config.toml.
3	#
4	# Runs under pwsh via [interpreters.ps1] in .chezmoi.toml.tmpl. chezmoi pipes the
5	# CURRENT target file into stdin and takes the new contents from stdout.
6	#
7	# WHY AN OVERLAY (this replaced a plain managed dot_config/herdr/config.toml):
8	# herdr rewrites this file at runtime — the onboarding flag, in-app settings
9	# popups, [session] / [remote] / [experimental] / [update] state. A plain managed
10	# file clobbers all of that on every `chezmoi apply`, which can re-trigger
11	# onboarding. The parent (unix) repo hit this and moved create_ -> modify_ on
12	# 2026-07-06; this repo's config was added five days later and still used the
13	# plain form. Same fix, ported.
14	#
15	# MERGE MODEL — template-as-base, pull-through unmanaged keys:
16	#   - Base = the managed template (.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml), which
17	#     carries the comments + the tmux-parity rationale.
18	#   - Every TOP-LEVEL key in the live file that is NOT managed and NOT already in
19	#     the template is copied across (preserves onboarding, [session], [remote],
20	#     [experimental], and any future herdr writeback).
21	#   - Managed tables are enforced wholesale (template wins).
22	#   - FORCED single keys are re-asserted INTO a pulled-through table, so the table
23	#     keeps herdr's own bookkeeping. Windows needs exactly one: update.channel
24	#     must stay "preview" (the installer rejects "stable" on Windows builds), but
25	#     [update] also holds herdr's last-check state, which we do not want to wipe.
26	#     This sub-key merge is the one deliberate divergence from the unix overlay.
27	#
28	# WHY tomlkit (not a hand-rolled emitter): herdr's config has an array-of-tables
29	# ([[keys.command]]) and comments worth keeping; stdlib tomllib is read-only.
30	# Python runtime: prefer `uv` (guarantees >=3.11 -> stdlib tomllib), fall back to
31	# system python, then to emitting the raw template (a fresh host with neither
32	# still gets a full config — note we emit the TEMPLATE, not stdin, because on a
33	# fresh host stdin is empty).
34	#
35	# To manage an additional key: edit .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.
36	# Validate the result with `herdr server reload-config` (empty diagnostics).
37	
38	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
39	
40	# Emit bytes verbatim so nothing re-encodes the config's ⭐ / box-drawing glyphs
41	# and no BOM or trailing CRLF churn creeps into chezmoi's diff.
42	function Write-StdoutBytes {
43	    param([byte[]] $Bytes)
44	    $out = [Console]::OpenStandardOutput()
45	    $out.Write($Bytes, 0, $Bytes.Length)
46	    $out.Flush()
47	}
48	
49	$utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)   # no BOM
50	
51	$templateText = @'
52	{{ template "herdr/config.toml" . }}
53	'@
54	
55	$liveText = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
56	
57	$tmpDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
58	$stamp = [System.IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName()
59	$tmplFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "herdr-tmpl-$stamp.toml"
60	$liveFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "herdr-live-$stamp.toml"
61	$pyFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "herdr-merge-$stamp.py"
62	$outFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "herdr-out-$stamp.toml"
63	
64	try {
65	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmplFile, $templateText, $utf8)
66	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($liveFile, $liveText, $utf8)
67	
68	    # Pick a Python. uv is in this repo's scoop package set; `python` is the
69	    # uv-managed default install (--default --preview creates the unversioned shim).
70	    $py = $null
71	    if (Get-Command uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
72	        $py = @('uv', 'run', '--no-project', '--quiet', '--with', 'tomlkit', '--python', '>=3.11', 'python')
73	    } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
74	        $py = @('python')
75	    } elseif (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
76	        $py = @('python3')
77	    }
78	
79	    if (-not $py) {
80	        [Console]::Error.WriteLine('modify_config.toml: no uv/python found; emitting managed template (runtime keys not preserved this run)')
81	        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($templateText)
82	        return
83	    }
84	
85	    $pySource = @'
86	import os
87	import sys
88	
89	tmpl_path = os.environ["HERDR_TEMPLATE_FILE"]
90	live_path = os.environ["HERDR_LIVE_FILE"]
91	out_path = os.environ["HERDR_OUT_FILE"]
92	
93	with open(tmpl_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
94	    template_text = fh.read()
95	
96	
97	def emit(text):
98	    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
99	        fh.write(text)
100	
101	
102	try:
103	    import tomllib  # Python 3.11+
104	except ModuleNotFoundError:
105	    try:
106	        import tomli as tomllib
107	    except ModuleNotFoundError:
108	        # No TOML reader -> can't safely merge; ship the managed template as-is.
109	        emit(template_text)
110	        sys.exit(0)
111	
112	try:
113	    import tomlkit
114	except ModuleNotFoundError:
115	    print(
116	        "modify_config.toml: tomlkit unavailable; emitting managed template "
117	        "(runtime keys not preserved this run)",
118	        file=sys.stderr,
119	    )
120	    emit(template_text)
121	    sys.exit(0)
122	
123	# Tables the template owns outright.
124	MANAGED = {"theme", "ui", "terminal", "keys"}
125	# Single keys re-asserted into an otherwise pulled-through table.
126	FORCED = {("update", "channel"): "preview"}
127	
128	with open(live_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
129	    live_text = fh.read().strip()
130	
131	doc = tomlkit.parse(template_text)  # base, with comments intact
132	try:
133	    live = tomllib.loads(live_text) if live_text else {}
134	except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError:
135	    # A corrupt live file must not block the apply — enforce the template.
136	    print("modify_config.toml: live config is not valid TOML; enforcing template", file=sys.stderr)
137	    live = {}
138	
139	for key, value in live.items():
140	    if key in MANAGED:
141	        continue
142	    if key in doc:
143	        # The template also declares this table. Keep herdr's runtime keys and
144	        # let the template win only on the keys it actually sets.
145	        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(doc[key], dict):
146	            for sub_key, sub_value in value.items():
147	                if sub_key not in doc[key]:
148	                    doc[key][sub_key] = sub_value
149	        continue
150	    doc[key] = value
151	
152	for (table, sub_key), forced_value in FORCED.items():
153	    if table not in doc:
154	        doc[table] = tomlkit.table()
155	    doc[table][sub_key] = forced_value
156	
157	emit(tomlkit.dumps(doc))
158	'@
159	
160	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($pyFile, $pySource, $utf8)
161	
162	    $env:HERDR_TEMPLATE_FILE = $tmplFile
163	    $env:HERDR_LIVE_FILE = $liveFile
164	    $env:HERDR_OUT_FILE = $outFile
165	
166	    $exe = $py[0]
167	    $rest = @($py[1..($py.Count - 1)]) + @($pyFile)
168	    & $exe @rest
169	    $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
170	
171	    if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile)) {
172	        [Console]::Error.WriteLine("modify_config.toml: merge failed (exit $rc); emitting managed template")
173	        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($templateText)
174	        return
175	    }
176	
177	    Write-StdoutBytes ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($outFile))
178	} finally {
179	    foreach ($f in $tmplFile, $liveFile, $pyFile, $outFile) {
180	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
181	    }
182	    foreach ($v in 'HERDR_TEMPLATE_FILE', 'HERDR_LIVE_FILE', 'HERDR_OUT_FILE') {
183	        Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
184	    }
185	}
186
```

{{ if eq .chezmoi.os "darwin" -}}

# input_method role uses Homebrew cask pkg installers (Squirrel) which invoke
# `sudo /usr/sbin/installer` internally. Pre-warm the sudo timestamp via the
# shared helper so the non-TTY child process finds a live ticket.
if [[ "$NEED_SUDO" == "1" ]]; then
    if sudo_session_init "ansible"; then
        case "$(sudo_session_skip_reason)" in
            cached)
                # Refresh the current TTY's sudo timestamp so the cask child
                # `sudo /usr/sbin/installer` finds a live ticket (it does not
                # accept a piped password). The watchdog keeps it warm every 50s.
                sudo_session_warm_cache || warn "sudo_session_warm_cache failed; pkg casks may still prompt"
                ;;
            passwordless)
                info "Passwordless sudo detected"
                ;;
=== 75,100 brewbundle ===

fi

{{ if eq .chezmoi.os "darwin" -}}
# --- Shared sudo session (see scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh)
# Inlined at render time. By the time brew-bundle runs, bootstrap and ansible
# will usually have already prompted + spawned the watchdog (which keeps the
# TTY timestamp warm every 50 s). `sudo_session_init` is idempotent: if the
# session already exists, it just re-exports env vars + re-registers traps.
# If the user invoked brew-bundle standalone (without the other phases), the
# prompt happens here instead.
{{ include "scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh" }}
# --- end sudo helper

# Pre-authenticate sudo so Homebrew cask pkg installers (e.g. google-drive,
# squirrel, ollama-app) can invoke /usr/sbin/installer without prompting from
# a non-TTY child. The watchdog refreshes the timestamp every 50 s, which
# is well inside sudo's default 5-minute tty_tickets window.
if sudo_session_init "brew"; then
    case "$(sudo_session_skip_reason)" in
        cached)
            # Warm the current TTY's timestamp right now so the FIRST cask
            # that shells out to `sudo /usr/sbin/installer` finds a live
            # ticket (cask installers read a TTY timestamp, not stdin).
            sudo_session_warm_cache || warn "sudo_session_warm_cache failed; pkg casks may prompt or fail"
            ;;
        passwordless)
            info "Passwordless sudo detected"
            ;;
        non-interactive | "")
            warn "Non-interactive mode without passwordless sudo - pkg-based casks may fail"

3	# UTF-8 console I/O. Without this, native tools that emit UTF-8 (git, winget's
4	# localized output, …) render as mojibake on legacy-codepage systems (e.g. GBK /
5	# cp936 on zh-* Windows). Guarded so a redirected/headless host can't error the
6	# rest of this fragment.
7	try {
8	    $utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
9	    [Console]::OutputEncoding = $utf8
10	    $OutputEncoding = $utf8
11	} catch { $null = $_ }
12	
13	# XDG-style base dirs. Several tools honor these on Windows (starship, atuin,
14	# zoxide state, our own copilot module) so we set them for a tidy $HOME.
15	if (-not $env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME) { $env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME = Join-Path $HOME '.config' }
16	if (-not $env:XDG_DATA_HOME)   { $env:XDG_DATA_HOME   = Join-Path $HOME '.local/share' }
17	if (-not $env:XDG_STATE_HOME)  { $env:XDG_STATE_HOME  = Join-Path $HOME '.local/state' }
18	if (-not $env:XDG_CACHE_HOME)  { $env:XDG_CACHE_HOME  = Join-Path $HOME '.cache' }
19	
20	$env:STARSHIP_CONFIG = Join-Path $env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME 'starship.toml'
21	# yazi looks in %APPDATA%\yazi\config by default; keep it XDG-consistent instead.
22	$env:YAZI_CONFIG_HOME = Join-Path $env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME 'yazi'
23	# herdr reads its config here instead of %APPDATA%\herdr\config.toml (XDG-tidy).
24	$env:HERDR_CONFIG_PATH = Join-Path $env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME 'herdr/config.toml'
25	
26	# yazi needs the MSYS `file.exe` (bundled with Git) for MIME detection; without
27	# it every entry errors "Cannot find `file` … Set it up per the Windows guide".
28	# scoop doesn't shim git's usr/bin, so point YAZI_FILE_ONE at file.exe directly;
29	# fall back to a system/winget Git install. First existing candidate wins.
30	if (-not $env:YAZI_FILE_ONE) {
31	    $fileOne = @(
32	        (Join-Path $HOME 'scoop/apps/git/current/usr/bin/file.exe'),
33	        'C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\file.exe'
34	    ) | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
35	    if ($fileOne) { $env:YAZI_FILE_ONE = $fileOne }
36	}
37	
38	# uv-managed Python: `uv python install --default` drops python/python3 here.
39	# ~/.local/bin is prepended to PATH below, so they win over the Windows Store
40	# `python.exe` app-execution-alias.
41	$env:UV_PYTHON_BIN_DIR = Join-Path $HOME '.local/bin'
42	
43	# Default editor
44	if (Get-Command nvim -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $env:EDITOR = 'nvim' }
45	
46	# Prepend user bin dirs to PATH, idempotently. scoop already adds its shims to
47	# the persisted user PATH, but a fresh session inside chezmoi apply may not have
48	# it yet; ~/.local/bin carries uv tools + the uv-managed python. Normalize each
49	# entry to backslashes (mixed slashes can fail Windows command resolution).
50	$UserPaths = @(
51	    (Join-Path $HOME '.local/bin'),
52	    (Join-Path $HOME 'scoop/shims'),
53	    # herdr has no scoop shim; its bin junction lives here (opt-in installHerdr).
54	    (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Herdr\bin')
55	) | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path $_) } |
56	    ForEach-Object { [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($_) } | Select-Object -Unique
57	
58	$SepPaths = $env:PATH -split ';'
59	foreach ($p in $UserPaths) {
60	    if ($SepPaths -notcontains $p) { $env:PATH = "$p;$env:PATH" }
61	}

```text
1	#Requires -Version 7
2	# run_onchange_after_03_xdg_env.ps1 — persist the XDG base-dir env vars to the
3	# User environment so ~/.config is authoritative for XDG-aware tools (Neovim,
4	# lazygit, starship, yazi, atuin, zoxide) even when launched OUTSIDE a pwsh
5	# session that sourced our profile.
6	#
7	# Why this matters on Windows:
8	#   * 00_env.ps1 sets these in-session, so tools launched from pwsh already use
9	#     ~/.config. But nvim launched from Explorer / a non-pwsh terminal would
10	#     fall back to %LOCALAPPDATA%\nvim for config AND a separate data/plugin
11	#     dir — a confusing "my plugins vanished" split.
12	#   * Setting XDG_CONFIG_HOME is also the Neovim-documented way to make it read
13	#     ~/.config/nvim on Windows, and lazygit honours it for config.yml too.
14	#
15	# Idempotent + fault-tolerant: only writes a var when it differs; never aborts.
16	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
17	
18	$want = @{
19	    XDG_CONFIG_HOME = Join-Path $HOME '.config'
20	    XDG_DATA_HOME   = Join-Path $HOME '.local\share'
21	    XDG_STATE_HOME  = Join-Path $HOME '.local\state'
22	    XDG_CACHE_HOME  = Join-Path $HOME '.cache'
23	}
24	
25	foreach ($name in $want.Keys) {
26	    try {
27	        $current = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, 'User')
28	        if ($current -ne $want[$name]) {
29	            [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $want[$name], 'User')
30	            Write-Host "==> set User env $name = $($want[$name])" -ForegroundColor Cyan
31	        }
32	    } catch {
33	        Write-Warning "could not set $name (non-fatal): $_"
34	    }
35	}
36
```

## GUI 應用程式（winget）

| 應用程式 | winget id |
|---|---|

| PowerToys | `Microsoft.PowerToys` |
| Raycast | `9PFXXSHC64H3`（msstore） |
| Antigravity | `Google.Antigravity` |
| Docker Desktop | `Docker.DockerDesktop`（WSL2 後端由 `installWsl` 開關提供 —— 見下方） |
| Discord | `Discord.Discord` |
| Claude Desktop | `Anthropic.Claude` |
| ChatGPT | `9PLM9XGG6VKS`（msstore） |

| Arc | `TheBrowserCompany.Arc` |
| Zen Browser | `Zen-Team.Zen-Browser` |
| Grammarly | `Grammarly.Grammarly` |
| Steam（gaming） | `Valve.Steam` |

**Docker Desktop 的 WSL2 後端**（`installWsl` 開關，workstation 預設開）由
`scripts/enable-wsl.ps1` 透過 `wsl --install --no-distribution` 安裝 —— 只裝 WSL2
平台、不裝 Linux 發行版（Docker 會自建 `docker-desktop` distro）。`wsl --install`
需要系統管理員**且**需重開機，所以未提權的 `chezmoi apply` 會自動提權（跳一次 UAC，
類似 scoop），執行安裝後印出重開機提示 —— 重開機後 Docker Desktop 即以 WSL2 後端啟動。
若要重跑或重試（例如 UAC 被拒），執行 `just enable-wsl`；已安裝的機器則為 no-op（不跳
UAC）。若在 proxy／公司網路／GFW 下 WSL app 下載被 reset（「连接被重置」），腳本會退而
| Local LLM tools | Ollama（`Ollama.Ollama`）+ LiteLLM（`uv tool install 'litellm[proxy]'`） |
| Tunnel tools | ngrok、cloudflared（scoop） |
| IaC tools | Terraform、OpenTofu（scoop）+ Azure CLI 與 `azure-devops` 擴充（`az devops`/`az repos`,winget） |
| OpenSSH server | Microsoft OpenSSH Server（sshd）：Windows capability + 自動啟動服務 + inbound TCP 22 防火牆規則，並以 pwsh 為預設 shell。需系統管理員 —— 用提升權限的 `chezmoi apply`，或在提升權限的 pwsh 執行 `just enable-sshd`。 |
| herdr multiplexer | herdr，原生 Windows 終端多工器（**preview beta**）。沒有 scoop/winget manifest —— 透過 herdr.dev 的 `irm \| iex` 腳本安裝；設定受管於 `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`（以 pwsh 為預設 shell）。見 [rationale](rationale.zh-TW.md#wezterm-herdr-beta)。 |
| Clink (cmd.exe) | [Clink](https://chrisant996.github.io/clink/)（scoop `main`）—— cmd.exe 的 Bash 風格行編輯，讓 **starship** + **zoxide** + **fzf** 也能用在 DOS 提示字元。沿用共用的 `starship.toml`；註冊使用者層級 cmd AutoRun、部署我們的 `starship.lua`，並把社群的 `clink-zoxide` / `clink-fzf` 橋接抓進 `%LocalAppData%\clink`。pwsh 仍是預設 —— 這是選用的次要 shell，只有 prompt + 導覽對等。見 [rationale](rationale.zh-TW.md#powershell-7-cmdexe-clink) 與 [Shell](shell.zh-TW.md#cmdexe-via-clink)。 |
| try（暫時性 workspace） | [`try`](https://github.com/tobi/try)，透過 `gem install try-cli` 安裝（若無 ruby 會一併裝）。建立以日期命名的 `~/src/tries/YYYY-MM-DD-name` 試驗目錄 + 模糊選擇器；`tri <git-url>` 會 clone 進其中一個。pwsh 指令是 **`tri`**（`try` 是保留字 —— 裸打 `try` 無法 parse；`& try` 可用）。見 [Shell](shell.zh-TW.md#try)。 |
| translate（workstation 預設開） | [`translate`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/translate) —— 終端機翻譯工具（CLI + TUI），走 copilot-proxy / Ollama / Google，另有離線的 CC-CEDICT + ECDICT 辭典。它沒有 scoop/winget manifest，也沒有預先編譯的 Windows release，所以用 `go install` 從原始碼編進 `~\.local\bin`（go 由該區塊自己裝，不必開「Extra runtimes」）；**第一次編譯要好幾分鐘**。附帶 pwsh tab 補全與 `translate` tv channel。見 [translate](translate.zh-TW.md)。 |

**China mirrors** 會把 pip / npm / cargo / go / node 的套件抓取導向 GFW 鏡像
（清華 / npmmirror / goproxy.cn / rsproxy），安裝時與互動式 shell
（`profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`）皆生效。

## Television（tv）channels

自訂選擇器放在 `%APPDATA%\television\cable\`（執行 `tv` 瀏覽，或 `tv <name>`）：

| Channel | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `aliases` | PowerShell aliases 與函式（shell 啟動時快取） |
| `git-ops` | 常用 git 指令 → Enter 複製到剪貼簿 |
| `ports` | 監聽中的 TCP ports → Ctrl+K 結束佔用的行程 |
| `kill-process` | 依記憶體排序的行程 → Enter/Ctrl+K 結束、Ctrl+D 強制結束 |
| `scoop-apps` | 已安裝的 scoop apps → Enter 資訊、Ctrl+U 更新、Ctrl+X 移除 |
| `apps` | 從開始功能表捷徑啟動應用程式 |
| `channels` | 依描述瀏覽所有 tv channel → Enter 開啟選定的 channel |
| `translate` | 翻譯歷史 → Enter 複製譯文、Ctrl+Y 複製原文、Ctrl+S 朗讀（選用的 `translate`） |

## 升級

安裝與升級刻意分開。`chezmoi apply` 只安裝缺少的東西；升級要明確執行：

```powershell
just upgrade-scoop     # scoop update *
just upgrade-winget    # winget upgrade --all
just upgrade-translate # go install …/translate@latest（選用工具，不含在 `just upgrade` 裡）
```
```
