- **LLM tools** (optional): Ollama local runtime, LiteLLM proxy, `llmfit` hardware-fit recommender, `models` TUI/CLI for model discovery and benchmarks
- **Input Methods** (optional): McBopomofo + RIME (Squirrel on macOS, ibus-rime on Linux)
- **Networking tools** (optional): nmap, arp-scan, mtr, iperf3, doggo, httpie, gping, trippy, bandwhich, speedtest, rustscan
- **Linux audit framework** (optional, Linux only, `installAuditd=true`): [`auditd`](docs/sysadmin/auditd.md) + baseline rule set (identity / sudoers / sshd_config / privileged-exec watches), plus `audit-*` shell helpers and `tv sessions` / `tv sudo-history` / `tv audit-events` Television channels for the routine "who did what on this server" queries. Full guide: [docs/sysadmin/](docs/sysadmin/README.md); ansible role: [docs/playbooks/auditd.md](docs/playbooks/auditd.md)
- **Homelab hardware monitoring** (optional, Linux/physical only, `installHomelabTools=true`): hardware-monitoring CLIs ([lm-sensors, smartmontools, ipmitool, nvme-cli, storcli](docs/sysadmin/hardware.md)) installed only when the matching hardware is detected, plus the `hw-*` shell helper family (`hw-fans`, `hw-temps`, `hw-raid`, `hw-smart`, `hw-status` …) for the "is this server's hardware healthy?" sweep. Full guide: [docs/sysadmin/hardware.md](docs/sysadmin/hardware.md)
- **Wake-on-LAN** (optional, Linux/physical only, `installWakeOnLan=true`): arm a box's wired NIC to power on remotely from a [magic packet](docs/sysadmin/wake-on-lan.md), persisted across reboots via a `wol@<iface>` systemd unit; send from any machine with the `wake` CLI (`wake <host>`) or `wakeonlan`. Wake-from-full-shutdown also needs a one-time BIOS change (Power On By PCI-E on, ErP off). Full guide: [docs/sysadmin/wake-on-lan.md](docs/sysadmin/wake-on-lan.md)
- **Media / AV tools** (optional, `installMediaTools=true`): [ffmpeg](docs/tools/ffmpeg.md), [ImageMagick](docs/tools/imagemagick.md), [exiftool](docs/tools/exiftool.md), [libvips](docs/tools/libvips.md). Plus three zsh helpers (`compress-video`, `extract-audio`, `to-wav16k`) at [`dot_config/zsh/tools/29_media.zsh`](dot_config/zsh/tools/29_media.zsh). Also satisfies `vhs`'s runtime ffmpeg dep.
- **System audio & media control** (cross-platform): `sys*` shell helpers — `sysvol` / `sysmute` (built-in, always available) and `sysplay` / `sysnow` (with `installMediaControl=true`, which adds `nowplaying-cli`/`switchaudio-osx` on macOS and `playerctl` on Linux). Enables remote one-key mute via `fleet exec --login -- sysmute on`. See [docs/tools/media-control.md](docs/tools/media-control.md).
- **.NET tools** (optional): .NET SDK via mise + `azure-cost-cli` (Azure cost analysis); see [docs/tools/dotnet-tools.md](docs/tools/dotnet-tools.md)
- **Docker**: OrbStack (macOS) or Docker Engine (Linux)
- **Cargo tools**: pueue (process queue manager), [`recon`](https://github.com/gavraz/recon) (Claude Code tmux dashboard — see [agent pane discovery](docs/tools/agent-panes-discovery.md))

3	# and its CLI (`herdr workspace|tab|pane|session …`) is the scripting surface that
4	# replaces tmux's new-session/split-window. This fragment gives the same
5	# muscle-memory commands the parent dotfiles have on Unix:
6	#
7	#   herdr-vibe / hvibe  — parametric multi-agent pack in a new workspace
8	#                         (N agent panes + lazygit tab + nvim tab)

14	#
15	# PORTING NOTES (why this isn't a line-for-line translation):
16	#   * jq -> ConvertFrom-Json (native; no jq dependency).
17	#   * The Unix helpers emit a *bash* on-exit wrapper (`trap '' INT; …; exec
18	#     $SHELL -l`). The pane shell here is pwsh (config.toml default_shell=pwsh),
19	#     so the wrapper is a pwsh script handed to the pane as
20	#     `pwsh -NoLogo [-NoExit] -EncodedCommand <base64>` — base64 sidesteps all the
21	#     nested-quote escaping that `herdr pane run "<cmd>"` would otherwise need.
22	#   * SpecStory has no Windows CLI (see the package script), so the agent-wrap
23	#     helper degrades to raw passthrough unless `specstory` is actually on PATH.
24	#   * Session targeting uses the modern $env:HERDR_SESSION lever (the Unix file
25	#     predates it and juggles HERDR_SOCKET_PATH by hand).

28	# only be exercised on a Windows box with herdr present. The guard below makes it
29	# a clean no-op everywhere else (same pattern as 35_yazi.ps1).
30	
31	# Skip entirely if herdr isn't installed (opt-in tool, not on every host).
32	if (-not (Get-Command herdr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { return }

# channels — meta-channel: browse every tv channel with its description.
# Windows port of the Unix awk version (parses each cable/*.toml [metadata] with
# pwsh; [char]34 = " so the regex never breaks the -Command "..." quoting).
# Enter opens the selected channel; the preview bats its TOML.

[metadata]
name = "channels"
description = "Browse all available tv channels with descriptions"

[source]
command = '''pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$q=[char]34; Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'television\cable\*.toml') | ForEach-Object { $c=Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw; $n=''; $d=''; if ($c -match ('(?m)^\s*name\s*=\s*'+$q+'([^'+$q+']*)'+$q)) { $n=$matches[1] }; if ($c -match ('(?m)^\s*description\s*=\s*'+$q+'([^'+$q+']*)'+$q)) { $d=$matches[1] }; if ($n) { $n+[char]9+$d } }"'''
display = '{split:\t:0}   —   {split:\t:1}'
output = '{split:\t:0}'

[preview]
command = '''pwsh -NoProfile -Command "bat -n --color=always (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'television\cable\{split:\t:0}.toml')"'''

[keybindings]
enter = "actions:open"

[actions.open]
description = "Open selected channel in tv"
command = '''pwsh -NoProfile -Command "tv {split:\t:0}"'''
mode = "execute"
=== config.toml head ===
# Television (tv) config — Windows. Deployed to %APPDATA%\television\config.toml.

tick_rate = 50
default_channel = "files"

global_history = false

[ui]

# herdr — native Windows terminal multiplexer + AI-agent orchestrator (preview beta).
#
# Windows port of the parent dotfiles repo's .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.
# It mirrors the tmux/unix keymap as closely as the Windows build allows; every

# (dot_config/herdr/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl). The overlay enforces the tables
# below on every `chezmoi apply` and preserves the keys herdr writes back at
# runtime (onboarding / [session] / [remote] / [experimental] / [update] state).
# Tracking this as a PLAIN managed file — which is what this repo did before —
# clobbers that writeback and can re-trigger onboarding.
#
# Schema: https://herdr.dev/docs/configuration/
# Full default: `herdr --default-config`
# Validate after editing: `herdr server reload-config` (expect empty diagnostics)
#
# Helper-script paths are baked ABSOLUTE at render time on purpose: `pwsh -File`
# does NOT expand a leading `~` (verified), and herdr passes the command string
# through without shell tilde expansion on Windows.
#
# Prefix is ctrl+b (herdr default, same as tmux).

[update]
# Windows builds are preview-only; the installer rejects "stable" here.
# Re-asserted by the overlay as a single key so herdr's own [update] bookkeeping
# (last-check timestamps etc.) survives an apply.
channel = "preview"

[theme]
name = "catppuccin"           # mocha (dark)
auto_switch = true            # follow OS light/dark

dark_name = "catppuccin"

#
# Why a merge (not a managed dot_claude/settings.json)? Claude Code rewrites
# this file at runtime (plugins it installs, permissions the user grants). A
# static managed file would clobber all of that on every apply. We instead
# recursively deep-merge only our keys in, preserving every live key.

$overlayJson = @'
{{ include "claude/settings-overlay.json" }}

 `./docs/index.md`

```text
1	# Windows dotfiles
2	
3	Native **Windows + PowerShell 7** dotfiles, managed by [chezmoi](https://chezmoi.io).
4	A self-contained, Windows-only companion to the cross-platform (macOS/Linux)
5	dotfiles at [daviddwlee84/dotfiles](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles) — the
6	PowerShell layer is written natively rather than ported line-by-line from the POSIX
7	shell config.
8	
9	!!! tip "Which repo do I install from?"
10	    - **Native Windows (PowerShell)** → this repo (`dotfiles-windows`).
11	    - **macOS / Linux / WSL** → [daviddwlee84/dotfiles](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles).
12	
13	## What you get
14	
15	- **Shell**: PowerShell 7 with a modular `$PROFILE` that dot-sources
16	  `~/.config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1`.
17	- **Prompt**: [starship](https://starship.rs) — the same `starship.toml` used on
18	  macOS/Linux.
19	- **CLI tools** via [scoop](https://scoop.sh): git, neovim, lazygit, zoxide, fzf,
20	  bat, eza, ripgrep, fd, gh, delta, jq, yazi, btop, mise, uv, node, bun.
21	- **AI agents**: Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, SpecStory, Antigravity.
22	- **Editors**: VSCode, Cursor, Notepad++ (shared settings + keybindings).
23	- **Apps** via [winget](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/):
24	  Windows Terminal, Alacritty, Raycast, PowerToys, Steam.
25	- **`copilot-proxy`** tool series, rewritten as a native PowerShell module — see
26	  [copilot-proxy](copilot-proxy.md).
27	- **`translate`** — terminal translator (CLI + TUI), built from source and wired up
28	  with tab-completion and a `tv` channel — see [translate](translate.md).
29	
30	## Quick start
31	
32	```powershell
33	irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows/main/bootstrap.ps1 | iex
34	```
35	
36	Full walkthrough: [Setup](setup.md). Design choices (why scoop, why starship, why
37	pwsh): [Rationale](rationale.md).
38	
39	## How it's organized
40	
41	| Path | What |
42	|---|---|
43	| `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` | Init prompts (role + feature toggles). |
44	| `Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1` | `$PROFILE` loader. |
45	| `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/` | Modular shell fragments. |
46	| `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/` | `copilot-proxy` module. |
47	| `.chezmoiscripts/` | Package install + editor/terminal overlays. |
48	| `bootstrap.ps1` | One-line installer. |
49	
50	!!! note "Scope"
51	    This repo targets native Windows only. WSL is covered by the separate
52	    cross-platform dotfiles (it's just another Linux host there).
53
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
=== WeaselDeployer.cpp arg parsing ===
// WeaselDeployer.cpp : Defines the entry point for the application.
//
#include "stdafx.h"
#include <WeaselUtility.h>
#include <fstream>
#include "WeaselDeployer.h"
#include "Configurator.h"

CAppModule _Module;

static int Run(LPTSTR lpCmdLine);

int APIENTRY _tWinMain(HINSTANCE hInstance,
                       HINSTANCE hPrevInstance,
                       LPTSTR lpCmdLine,
                       int nCmdShow) {
  UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(hPrevInstance);

  LANGID langId = get_language_id();
  SetThreadUILanguage(langId);
  SetThreadLocale(langId);

  HRESULT hRes = ::CoInitialize(NULL);
  // If you are running on NT 4.0 or higher you can use the following call
  // instead to make the EXE free threaded. This means that calls come in on a
  // random RPC thread.
  // HRESULT hRes = ::CoInitializeEx(NULL, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
  ATLASSERT(SUCCEEDED(hRes));

  // this resolves ATL window thunking problem when Microsoft Layer for Unicode
  // (MSLU) is used
  ::DefWindowProc(NULL, 0, 0, 0L);

  AtlInitCommonControls(
      ICC_BAR_CLASSES);  // add flags to support other controls

  hRes = _Module.Init(NULL, hInstance);
  ATLASSERT(SUCCEEDED(hRes));

  CreateDirectory(WeaselUserDataPath().c_str(), NULL);

  int ret = 0;
  HANDLE hMutex = CreateMutex(NULL, TRUE, L"WeaselDeployerExclusiveMutex");
  if (!hMutex) {
    ret = 1;
  } else if (GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) {
    ret = 1;
  } else {
    ret = Run(lpCmdLine);
  }

  if (hMutex) {
    CloseHandle(hMutex);
  }
  _Module.Term();
  ::CoUninitialize();

  return ret;
}

static int Run(LPTSTR lpCmdLine) {
  Configurator configurator;
  configurator.Initialize();

  if (!wcscmp(L"/?", lpCmdLine) || !wcscmp(L"/help", lpCmdLine)) {
    WCHAR msg[1024] = {0};
    if (LoadString(GetModuleHandle(NULL), IDS_STR_HELP, msg,
                   sizeof(msg) / sizeof(TCHAR))) {
      MessageBox(NULL, msg, L"Weasel Deployer", MB_ICONINFORMATION | MB_OK);
    } else {
      MessageBox(NULL,
                 L"Usage: WeaselDeployer.exe [options]\n"
                 L"/? or /help		- Show this help message\n"
                 L"/deploy		- Update Workspace\n"
                 L"/dict		- Manage dictionary\n"
                 L"/sync		- Sync user data\n"
                 L"/install		- Install Weasel (Initial deployment)",
                 L"Weasel Deployer", MB_ICONINFORMATION | MB_OK);
    }
    return 0;
  }

  bool deployment_scheduled = !wcscmp(L"/deploy", lpCmdLine);
  if (deployment_scheduled) {
    return configurator.UpdateWorkspace();
  }

  bool dict_management = !wcscmp(L"/dict", lpCmdLine);
  if (dict_management) {
    return configurator.DictManagement();
  }

  bool sync_user_dict = !wcscmp(L"/sync", lpCmdLine);
  if (sync_user_dict) {
    return configurator.SyncUserData();
  }

  bool installing = !wcscmp(L"/install", lpCmdLine);
  return configurator.Run(installing);
}
```

```powershell
chezmoi diff            # 預覽即將套用的變更

name: docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['docs/**', 'mkdocs.yml', 'pyproject.toml']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
      - name: Build site
        run: uv run --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-static-i18n mkdocs build --strict
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: site

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
```

  WriteUninstaller "$INSTDIR\uninstall.exe"

  DisableAutoCheckUpdate:

---
# Input method role - Traditional Chinese input methods
# macOS: McBopomofo + Squirrel (RIME) via Homebrew cask
# Linux: ibus-rime via apt

# =============================================================================
# macOS: McBopomofo
# =============================================================================

- name: Check if McBopomofo is installed (macOS)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /Library/Input Methods/McBopomofo.app
  register: mcbopomofo_check

- name: Install McBopomofo via Homebrew cask (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - not mcbopomofo_check.stat.exists
  community.general.homebrew_cask:
    name: mcbopomofo
    state: present

# =============================================================================
# macOS: Squirrel (RIME)
# =============================================================================

- name: Check if Squirrel (RIME) is installed (macOS)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app
  register: squirrel_check

- name: Install Squirrel (RIME) via Homebrew cask (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - not squirrel_check.stat.exists
  community.general.homebrew_cask:
    name: squirrel
    state: present
  failed_when: false
  register: squirrel_install_result

- name: Re-check Squirrel after install attempt (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - not squirrel_check.stat.exists
  ansible.builtin.stat:
    path: /Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app
  register: squirrel_recheck

- name: Warn Squirrel install requires sudo (macOS)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
    - squirrel_recheck.stat is defined
    - not squirrel_recheck.stat.exists
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: >-
      Squirrel cask install needs sudo (pkg installer) and chezmoi/ansible runs non-interactively on macOS.
      Run manually in a terminal: brew install --cask squirrel

# =============================================================================
# Linux: ibus-rime
# =============================================================================

- name: Install ibus-rime (Ubuntu)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: ibus-rime
    state: present
    # Universe package covered by base's best-effort cache refresh; don't re-run
    # apt-get update here (a broken/flaky source would abort the play).
    # See pitfalls/apt-update-fails-base-role-empty-error.md.
    update_cache: false
```

The repo relies entirely on the schemas bundled with the Squirrel cask / `ibus-rime` deb.

### Net summary for a Windows/Weasel port

The companion repo gives you an **install-only precedent, no config precedent**. What you can reuse: the `installInputMethod` chezmoi config-key name and its desktop-profile gating pattern, the ansible-role-per-concern layout, the "check for existing app, then install, then warn instead of fail" idempotency shape, and — most importantly — the documented *policy* in `docs/input_methods/README.md` about which files are source-of-truth (`*.custom.yaml` only) versus runtime noise (`build/`, `*.userdb/`, `installation.yaml`, `user.yaml`). If the Windows repo is going to manage `weasel.custom.yaml` / `default.custom.yaml` under `%APPDATA%\Rime`, it will be the **first** place in either repo where Rime config is actually version-controlled, and there is a documented, still-open intent on the macOS side to eventually do the same (priority list at `docs/input_methods/README.md:254-263`) — so a shared-YAML design is a genuinely open door, not a retrofit against an existing scheme.

LPCTSTR GetParamByPrefix(LPCTSTR lpCmdLine, LPCTSTR prefix) {
  return (wcsncmp(lpCmdLine, prefix, wcslen(prefix)) == 0)
             ? (lpCmdLine + wcslen(prefix))
             : 0;
}

static int Run(LPTSTR lpCmdLine) {
  constexpr bool silent = true;

    WCHAR msg[1024] = {0};
    if (LoadString(GetModuleHandle(NULL), IDS_STR_HELP, msg,
                   sizeof(msg) / sizeof(TCHAR))) {
      MessageBox(NULL, msg, L"WeaselSetup", MB_ICONINFORMATION | MB_OK);

          L"/? or /help    - Show this help message\n"
          L"/u             - Uninstall Weasel\n"
          L"/i             - Install Weasel\n"
          L"/s             - Install Weasel (Simplified Chinese)\n"
          L"/t             - Install Weasel (Traditional Chinese)\n"
          L"/ls            - Set Weasel language to Simplified Chinese\n"

          L"/le            - Set Weasel language to English\n"

          L"/du            - Disable automatic update check\n"
          L"/toggleime     - Toggle IME on open/close(ctrl+space)\n"
          L"/toggleascii   - Toggle ASCII on open/close(ctrl+space)\n"
          L"/testing       - Set update channel to testing\n"
          L"/release       - Set update channel to release\n"
          L"/userdir:<dir> - Set user directory\n",
          L"WeaselSetup", MB_ICONINFORMATION | MB_OK);
    }
    return 0;
  }
  bool uninstalling = !wcscmp(L"/u", lpCmdLine);
  if (uninstalling) {
    if (IsProcAdmin())
      return uninstall(silent);
    else
      return RestartAsAdmin(lpCmdLine);
  }

  if (auto res = GetParamByPrefix(lpCmdLine, L"/userdir:")) {
    return SetRegKeyValue(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, L"Software\\Rime\\weasel",
                          L"RimeUserDir", res, REG_SZ);

# Windows dotfiles — chezmoi config template.
# Rendered once at `chezmoi init`; answers are stored in
# %USERPROFILE%\.config\chezmoi\chezmoi.toml and never re-asked.
#
# This repo targets **native Windows + PowerShell 7 (pwsh)** only. There is no

    # role picks coarse defaults; every toggle can still be overridden.

```

**Patterns to follow:**

- **Prompt helper signatures**: `promptBoolOnce . "<varName>" "<prompt text>" <default>`; `promptStringOnce . "<var>" "<text>" <default> | quote`; `promptChoiceOnce . "<var>" "<text>" (list "a" "b") "<default>" | quote`. Note: string/choice results get `| quote`; bools do not.
- **role → defaults**: `{{- $role := promptChoiceOnce ... }}` then `{{- $full := eq $role "workstation" }}`. A toggle that should be on for workstation passes `$full` as its default; an opt-in toggle passes `false`. For choices, `(ternary "notify" "none" $full)` is the role-conditional idiom.
- **Naming convention**: `install<ThingPascalCase>` camelCase (`installHerdr`, `installClink`, `installTry`, `installTranslate`, `installWindowsApps`). Non-install toggles use plain camelCase (`useChineseMirror`, `managedMachine`, `backupMode`, `enableVimMode`, `agentSounds`). Assignments are `=`-aligned in a column (2 spaces of indent + padded var names; `installSpecstoryBuild` is the one that overflows the column).
- **Where new prompts go**: inside the `# --- feature toggles (role-defaulted) ---` block. Precedent from commit `77c56d5` (translate): the new toggle was inserted **after the other `installX` toggles and immediately before `useChineseMirror`**, i.e. the trailing four (`useChineseMirror`, `managedMachine`, `backupMode`, `enableVimMode`) stay last. Multi-line `#` comments explaining *why* a tool is unusual go directly above its line.
- **Hard rule**: prompt text must contain **no `=`** (chezmoi's `name=value` flag parser splits on the first `=`) — enforced by the Pester test.

# 2. `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl`

`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-windows-dotfiles/.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` (565 lines). Structure:

**Header (lines 1–23)** — a comment block that *echoes every toggle*, which is both documentation and the run_onchange trigger (rendering changes when a toggle changes):

```powershell
# Toggles (from .chezmoi.toml.tmpl):
#   installCodingAgents  = {{ .installCodingAgents }}
...
#   installTranslate     = {{ .installTranslate }}
#   useChineseMirror     = {{ .useChineseMirror }}
#   managedMachine       = {{ .managedMachine }}
```
**A new toggle must be added to this list too** (it is how the script knows to re-fire).

**Preamble (28–45)**: `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'`, `$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false`, `$script:Failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()`, UTF-8 console, `{{ if .useChineseMirror }}` mirror env block, then:

```powershell
function Info($m) { Write-Host "==> $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
function Have($n) { [bool](Get-Command $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) }
function Register-Failure($what) { $script:Failures.Add($what); Write-Warning "FAILED (skipped): $what" }
```

`Register-Failure` just appends a label string to `$script:Failures` and warns. Label convention is `"<source>:<name>"` — `scoop:foo`, `winget:Some.Id`, `msstore:9PXXXX`, `npm:pkg`, `uv:apprise`, `gh-ext:gh-dash`, `gem:try-cli`, `go:translate@v0.5.2`, `clink-plugin:fzf.lua`, or a bare name (`herdr`, `peon-ping`). Failures never abort; the tail (lines 558–564) prints the summary.

**scoop declarations** — buckets are added in `Ensure-Scoop`:

```powershell
foreach ($b in 'main', 'extras', 'versions', 'nerd-fonts') {
    scoop bucket add $b *> $null
}
```

Packages via `Scoop-Install([string[]]$apps)`, which diffs against `scoop export | ConvertFrom-Json` and batch-installs only the missing set, then re-checks and `Register-Failure "scoop:$name"` for stragglers. Bucket-qualified names are supported (`'extras/opencode-desktop'`) — the `($_ -split '/')[-1]` handles the prefix. Baseline set is one big `Scoop-Install @( ... )` at line 162.

**winget declarations** — exact code:

```powershell
function Winget-Install([string]$id) {
    if (-not (Have winget)) { Register-Failure "winget:$id (winget unavailable)"; return }
    winget list --id $id -e --accept-source-agreements *> $null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { return }   # already installed
    Info "winget install $id"
    winget install --id $id -e --silent --scope user `
        --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        # some packages don't support --scope user; retry machine scope.
        winget install --id $id -e --silent `
            --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure "winget:$id" }
}
```

Note: **no `--source winget` flag is passed** for normal winget packages (default source). Store-only apps use the separate helper:

```powershell
function Winget-InstallStore([string]$id) {
    ...
    winget install --id $id -e --source msstore --silent `
        --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure "msstore:$id" }
}
```
(msstore ignores `--scope`, so it isn't passed; ids are Store product ids like `9PFXXSHC64H3`.)

Other installers: `Npm-InstallGlobal([string[]]$pkgs)`, `Install-Herdr` (irm|iex from `https://herdr.dev/install.ps1`, idempotent via `Test-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Herdr\bin\herdr.exe`), `uv tool install`, `Install-Module`.

**Toggle gating** — Go-template `if` around whole blocks, always with the `-}}`/`{{ if X -}}` whitespace-chomping form so the rendered .ps1 stays clean:

```gotmpl
{{ if .installWindowsApps -}}
# GUI apps + editors via winget.
foreach ($id in @(
    'Microsoft.VisualStudioCode',
    'Anysphere.Cursor',
    ...
    'Zen-Team.Zen-Browser'
{{- if not .managedMachine }},
    'Grammarly.Grammarly'   # skipped on managed machines (often policy-blocked)
{{- end }}
)) { Winget-Install $id }

Winget-InstallStore '9PFXXSHC64H3'   # Raycast
Winget-InstallStore '9PLM9XGG6VKS'   # ChatGPT (OpenAI)

Scoop-Install @('Hack-NF', 'Hack-NF-Mono')
{{ end -}}
```

Nested conditional list entries use the `{{- if ... }},\n    'Id'\n{{- end }}` comma-leading form so the array stays valid PowerShell either way.

**Where a NEW opt-in GUI app block goes**: after the existing gated blocks, in the same order as the toggles in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`. The tail of the file is a sequence of one-toggle blocks:

```
{{ if .installGamingApps -}}   line 417
{{ if .installUtilityApps -}}  line 421
{{ if .installLlmTools -}}     line 440
{{ if .installTunnelTools -}}  line 446
{{ if .installIacTools -}}     line 450
{{ if .installHerdr -}}        line 464   -> Install-Herdr
{{ if .installClink -}}        line 468   -> Scoop-Install @('clink') + post-install wiring
{{ if .installTry -}}          line 498
{{ if .installTranslate -}}    line 515
```
…then the `$script:Failures` summary at 558. A new tool's block belongs **between line 556 (`{{ end -}}` of translate) and line 558**, i.e. the last gated block before the summary — that is exactly where `installTranslate` was appended in `77c56d5`.

An opt-in tool block that is "self-contained" is the house style: e.g. the `installTry` block calls `Scoop-Install @('ruby')` even though `installExtraRuntimes` may already provide it, and `installTranslate` calls `Scoop-Install @('go')`, with the comment "self-contained: installExtraRuntimes may well be off".

Note the convention captured in the inline comments: toggles are set `false` in CI **except** where a `true` is needed to exercise a template branch (coding agents, specstory build, translate, `agentSounds=both`), because `chezmoi apply --exclude scripts` means nothing actually installs. **If you want your new tool's block render-checked, set it `=true` and add the "why true" comment.**

5. **Parse-check rendered `.ps1.tmpl` scripts** — exact step:

```powershell
$failed = $false
Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.ps1.tmpl | ForEach-Object {
  $rendered = Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName | chezmoi execute-template --source .
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $rendered) { Write-Host "RENDER FAIL: $($_.Name)"; $failed = $true; return }
  $errors = $null
  [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput($rendered, [ref]$null, [ref]$errors) | Out-Null
  if ($errors) { Write-Host "PARSE FAIL: $($_.Name)"; $errors | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $_" }; $failed = $true }
  else { Write-Host "OK:   $($_.Name)" }
}
if ($failed) { throw 'A rendered template failed to render or parse' }
```

6. **chezmoi apply (files only)** — `chezmoi apply --source $PWD --destination $dest --exclude scripts --verbose` into `$env:RUNNER_TEMP\dothome`, then prints the deployed tree (so a newly-deployed config dir shows up in CI logs).
7. **Pester tests** — `Invoke-Pester -CI -Path . -Output Detailed`.

# 4. `tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` — parity validation

`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-windows-dotfiles/tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1`. It regex-scrapes both files (matching on prompt **text**, not variable name):

```powershell
$script:Prompts = [regex]::Matches((Get-Content -Raw $tomlTmpl),
    'prompt(?<kind>Bool|String|Choice)Once\s+\.\s+"(?<var>[^"]+)"\s+"(?<text>[^"]+)"')
$script:Flags = [regex]::Matches((Get-Content -Raw $workflow),
    "'--prompt(?<kind>Bool|String|Choice)'\s*,\s*'(?<text>[^=']+)=")
```

Five assertions in `Describe 'init prompts vs CI flags (invariant #1)'`:
1. `finds prompts in .chezmoi.toml.tmpl` — `Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 10`
2. `finds prompt flags in windows.yml` — same
3. `has a CI flag for every init prompt` — failure message prints a paste-ready line: `"            '--prompt$($_.Kind)','$($_.Text)=<value>',   # $($_.Var)"`
4. `has no stale CI flag without a matching prompt` (catches half-renames)
5. `uses the right flag kind for each prompt` (Bool vs Choice vs String mismatch)
6. `has no "=" in any prompt text`

Caveat documented in the file: **no angle brackets in `Describe`/`It` names** (Pester treats `<...>` as a data placeholder). Run locally: `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1`.

# 5. Existing optional tools with BOTH a toggle and deployed config

There are three complementary precedents. **Yes — `.chezmoiignore` is itself a chezmoi template and uses `{{ if not .toggle }}` blocks. That is the *only* mechanism used for conditional config deployment in this repo.**

### 5a. herdr — `installHerdr` (config under `~/.config`, `modify_` overlay)

- **Toggle**: `installHerdr` (default `false`), `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl:42`.
- **Packages block** (`run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl:464-466`):
  ```gotmpl
  {{ if .installHerdr -}}
  Install-Herdr
  {{ end -}}
  ```
  with `function Install-Herdr` at lines 143-156 (irm|iex, `$env:HERDR_CHANNEL='preview'`, idempotent, `Register-Failure 'herdr'`).
- **Config source tree** (target `~/.config/herdr/...`):
  - `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-windows-dotfiles/dot_config/herdr/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` — the merge script
  - `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-windows-dotfiles/.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml` — the managed body, pulled in with `{{ template "herdr/config.toml" . }}` inside a PowerShell here-string
  - six plain `.ps1` helpers + `plugins/config/cloudmanic.herdr-plus/**` (`.toml` and `.toml.tmpl`)
- **Merge script**: *not* `run_onchange` — a chezmoi `modify_` script (stdin = live file, stdout = new content), running under pwsh via `[interpreters.ps1]`. It shells to `uv run --with tomlkit` (fallback `python`/`python3`, final fallback: emit the template) to preserve herdr's runtime writeback. `MANAGED = {"theme","ui","terminal","keys"}`, `FORCED = {("update","channel"): "preview"}`.
- **`.chezmoiignore` gate** (target paths, `.config/` not `dot_config/`):
  ```gotmpl
  {{ if not .installHerdr }}
  .config/herdr/**
  AppData/Roaming/television/cable/herdr-*.toml
  {{ end }}
  ```
- Env wiring: `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/00_env.ps1` sets `$env:HERDR_CONFIG_PATH` and prepends `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Herdr\bin` to PATH; `profile.d/25_herdr.ps1` self-guards with `if (-not (Get-Command herdr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { return }`.

### 5b. Clink — `installClink` (config under `%LOCALAPPDATA%`) — closest analogue to an `%APPDATA%` config dir

- **Source path**: `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-windows-dotfiles/AppData/Local/clink/starship.lua` — note the source dir is the literal `AppData/Local/...`, **no `dot_` prefix, no attribute prefixes**; the target is `$HOME\AppData\Local\clink\starship.lua`.
- **`.chezmoiignore` gate**:
  ```gotmpl
  # Clink profile (starship.lua for cmd.exe) is only deployed when the opt-in
  # installClink toggle is on. The zoxide/fzf Clink bridges are fetched at apply
  # time by the packages script, not managed here.
  {{ if not .installClink }}
  AppData/Local/clink/**
  {{ end }}
  ```
- **Packages block** (lines 468-496) shows the "install + post-install wiring" shape: `Scoop-Install @('clink')`, then `if (Have clink) { clink autorun install; ...download plugins...; clink set ... } else { Register-Failure 'clink (autorun/plugins not configured)' }`.
- The deployed file itself carries a comment pointing back at the gate: `-- Deployed only when the opt-in installClink toggle is on (see .chezmoiignore).`

**For a `%APPDATA%` GUI-app config the exact same shape applies**: source `AppData/Roaming/<AppName>/<file>` (add `.tmpl` if it needs templating — see `AppData/Roaming/alacritty/alacritty.toml.tmpl`, which is templated purely to bake `working_directory = '{{ .chezmoi.homeDir }}'`), and ignore-gate `AppData/Roaming/<AppName>/**`.

### 5c. translate — `installTranslate` (single conditional file under `%APPDATA%`)

- `.chezmoiignore`:
  ```gotmpl
  {{ if not .installTranslate }}
  AppData/Roaming/television/cable/translate.toml
  {{ end }}
  ```
- Packages block at 515-556 (version-pinned `go install`, `Register-Failure "go:translate@$translateVersion"`).
- Shell integration: one block appended to `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/10_tools.ps1`:
  `Import-CachedInit -Name 'translate' -Exe 'translate' -Generate { translate completion powershell }`.

# 8. `TODO.md`, `add-todo.sh`, skill "What's enabled"

**`TODO.md`** (`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-windows-dotfiles/TODO.md`): fixed section order `## P1`, `## P2`, `## P3`, `## P?`, `## Done`. Item syntax:

```markdown
- [ ] **[S] Title** — description with file paths if helpful.
- [ ] **[M] Title** — description → [research](backlog/slug.md)
- [ ] **[?/L] Title** — what spike would answer the question? → [research](backlog/slug.md)
- ✅ [2026-07-11] [P3/S] Title — one-line summary of what landed and where.
```
Effort tags `S|M|L|XL`; `P?` lane uses `[?/Effort]`. Only top-level `- [ ]` / `- ✅` items are parsed by the validator; prose/blockquotes/sub-bullets are ignored.

**Scripts** live under the vendored skill, not `scripts/`: `/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-windows-dotfiles/.agents/skills/project-knowledge-harness/scripts/{add-todo.sh,promote-todo.sh,todo-kanban.sh,sweep-inbox.sh,init.sh}` (`.claude/skills/project-knowledge-harness` is a symlink to `../../.agents/skills/project-knowledge-harness`). AGENTS.md refers to them as `scripts/add-todo.sh`; the repo's own `scripts/` dir contains only PowerShell/py helpers, so use the skill path.

Usage:
```
add-todo.sh --priority {P1|P2|P3|P?} --effort {S|M|L|XL|?} --title TEXT --description TEXT
            [--backlog] [--slug SLUG] [--file PATH] [--backlog-dir DIR]
            [--template PATH] [--validator PATH] [--dry-run]
```
`--backlog` scaffolds `backlog/<slug>.md` and appends ` → [research](backlog/<slug>.md)`. The validator (`todo-kanban.sh --validate-only TODO.md`) re-runs after the edit and restores the original on failure. Shipping an item: `promote-todo.sh --title "<substring>" --summary "<one-line>"`.

## Condensed checklist for adding a new optional GUI app + `%APPDATA%` config

1. `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` — add `installFoo = {{ promptBoolOnce . "installFoo" "Install Foo (…)" false }}` in the toggles block, before `useChineseMirror`; no `=` in the text.
2. `.github/workflows/windows.yml` — add `'--promptBool','Install Foo (…)=false'` (or `=true` + a why-true comment if you want the block render-checked) in the same position in `$flags`.
3. `tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` — nothing to edit; just run `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1`.
4. `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` — add `#   installFoo           = {{ .installFoo }}` to the header list, and a `{{ if .installFoo -}} … {{ end -}}` block just before the `$script:Failures` summary, using `Winget-Install 'Publisher.Foo'` / `Winget-InstallStore '<StoreId>'` / `Scoop-Install @('bucket/foo')`; any bespoke step wraps its own `Register-Failure "…"`.
5. Config: `AppData/Roaming/Foo/<file>` in the source tree (append `.tmpl` only if it needs `{{ .chezmoi.homeDir }}`-style data); gate it in `.chezmoiignore` with a commented `{{ if not .installFoo }} AppData/Roaming/Foo/** {{ end }}` block at the bottom. Use a `modify_*.ps1.tmpl` overlay + `.chezmoitemplates/foo/<file>` instead of a plain file **if the app rewrites its own config at runtime**.
6. Consider adding the config path to `$targets` in `.chezmoiscripts/run_once_before_01_backup.ps1.tmpl`.
7. Docs: rows in `docs/tools.md` + `docs/tools.zh-TW.md` (GUI table and/or the "Opt-in dev stacks" toggle table), a row in `docs/setup.md` + `docs/setup.zh-TW.md` prompt tables; a dedicated `docs/foo.md` + `docs/foo.zh-TW.md` + `mkdocs.yml` `nav`/`nav_translations` only if it warrants a page.
8. `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md` — append `· Foo: {{ .installFoo }}` to the second "What's enabled" line, plus a `## Gotchas` bullet if non-obvious.
9. `TODO.md` / `backlog/<slug>.md` for anything deferred (via `.agents/skills/project-knowledge-harness/scripts/add-todo.sh`), `pitfalls/<symptom>.md` for anything that cost >15 min to debug.
10. Optional: a `just` recipe (mirroring `install-fonts-machine-wide` / `enable-sshd`) and a self-guarding `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/NN_foo.ps1` fragment beginning with `if (-not (Get-Command foo -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { return }`.

I'm also checking whether Weasel's `/T` flag (Traditional Chinese) is necessary given the user's Taiwan-based setup. The winget `--custom` parameter can append `/T` to the installer command line, so `winget install --id Rime.Weasel -e --silent --custom "/T"` would invoke the installer with both `/S` and `/T` flags, which GetOptions can parse in either order.

But there's a safer, more robust approach: pre-set the registry keys before installation. Setting `HKCU\Software\Rime\Weasel\Hant` to 1 and `HKCU\Software\Rime\Weasel\RimeUserDir` to the desired path means WeaselSetup's `CustomInstall` will detect the Traditional Chinese preference and skip the interactive dialog entirely, regardless of whether the install runs silently or not.

The tricky part is that winget runs elevated, but the HKCU registry of the elevated process is still the same user's hive, so that should work fine. Though I should double-check what `/t` actually does in the Run() function to make sure I'm targeting the right install mode.

// https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows/win32/api/securitybaseapi/nf-securitybaseapi-checktokenmembership
bool IsProcAdmin() {
  BOOL b = FALSE;
  SID_IDENTIFIER_AUTHORITY NtAuthority = SECURITY_NT_AUTHORITY;
  PSID AdministratorsGroup;
  b = AllocateAndInitializeSid(&NtAuthority, 2, SECURITY_BUILTIN_DOMAIN_RID,
                               DOMAIN_ALIAS_RID_ADMINS, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                               &AdministratorsGroup);

  if (b) {
    if (!CheckTokenMembership(NULL, AdministratorsGroup, &b)) {
      b = FALSE;
    }
    FreeSid(AdministratorsGroup);
  }

  return (b);
}

int RestartAsAdmin(LPTSTR lpCmdLine) {
  SHELLEXECUTEINFO execInfo{0};
  TCHAR path[MAX_PATH];
  GetModuleFileName(GetModuleHandle(NULL), path, _countof(path));
  execInfo.lpFile = path;
  execInfo.lpParameters = lpCmdLine;
  execInfo.lpVerb = _T("runas");
  execInfo.cbSize = sizeof(execInfo);
  execInfo.nShow = SW_SHOWNORMAL;
  execInfo.fMask = SEE_MASK_NOASYNC | SEE_MASK_NOCLOSEPROCESS;
  execInfo.hwnd = NULL;
  execInfo.hProcess = NULL;
  if (::ShellExecuteEx(&execInfo) && execInfo.hProcess != NULL) {
    ::WaitForSingleObject(execInfo.hProcess, INFINITE);
    DWORD dwExitCode = 0;
    ::GetExitCodeProcess(execInfo.hProcess, &dwExitCode);
    ::CloseHandle(execInfo.hProcess);
    return dwExitCode;
  }
  return -1;
}

# --- winget ----------------------------------------------------------------
function Winget-Install([string]$id) {
    if (-not (Have winget)) { Register-Failure "winget:$id (winget unavailable)"; return }
    winget list --id $id -e --accept-source-agreements *> $null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { return }   # already installed
    Info "winget install $id"
    winget install --id $id -e --silent --scope user `
        --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        # some packages don't support --scope user; retry machine scope.
        winget install --id $id -e --silent `
            --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
    }
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure "winget:$id" }
}

# Microsoft Store packages (installed by Store product id via the msstore
# source) — used for apps with no community winget manifest, e.g. Raycast and the
# official ChatGPT desktop app. msstore ignores --scope, so we don't pass it.
function Winget-InstallStore([string]$id) {
    if (-not (Have winget)) { Register-Failure "msstore:$id (winget unavailable)"; return }
    winget list --id $id -e --accept-source-agreements *> $null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { return }   # already installed
    Info "winget (msstore) install $id"
    winget install --id $id -e --source msstore --silent `
        --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure "msstore:$id" }
}

# --- npm CLI agents --------------------------------------------------------
function Npm-InstallGlobal([string[]]$pkgs) {
    if (-not (Have npm)) { foreach ($p in $pkgs) { Register-Failure "npm:$p (npm unavailable)" }; return }
    foreach ($p in $pkgs) {
        Info "npm i -g $p"
        npm install -g $p 2>&1 | Out-Host
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure "npm:$p" }
    }
}

# --- herdr (native Windows terminal multiplexer, preview beta) --------------
# No scoop/winget/npm manifest — installs via herdr.dev's irm|iex bootstrap
# (same shape as Ensure-Scoop). Windows builds are preview-only; the bin junction
# is %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Herdr\bin (added to PATH in profile.d/00_env.ps1).
function Install-Herdr {
    $herdrBin = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Herdr\bin\herdr.exe'
    if ((Have herdr) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $herdrBin)) { Info 'herdr already installed'; return }
    Info 'installing herdr (preview) via herdr.dev/install.ps1'
    try {
        $env:HERDR_CHANNEL = 'preview'   # Windows builds are preview-only
        $installer = [scriptblock]::Create((Invoke-RestMethod https://herdr.dev/install.ps1))
        & $installer
        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $herdrBin)) { Register-Failure 'herdr' }
    } catch {
        Write-Warning "herdr install error: $_"
        Register-Failure 'herdr'
    }
}

# ===========================================================================
Ensure-Scoop

# Core CLI toolset — the shell baseline, always installed.
Scoop-Install @(

{{ if .installTranslate -}}
# translate -- terminal translator CLI+TUI (github.com/daviddwlee84/translate).
# There is no scoop/winget manifest and no prebuilt Windows release, so it is
# built from source with `go install` -- the same path the parent repo takes on
# Linux (dot_ansible/roles/go_tools); macOS there uses the Homebrew tap.
# GOBIN/GOPATH mirror that unix convention: the binary lands in ~/.local/bin
# (already on PATH via profile.d/00_env.ps1) and the module cache in
# ~/.local/share/go rather than recreating ~/go.
#
# It is pure Go (modernc.org/sqlite -- no cgo) and cross-compiles cleanly for
# windows/amd64 and windows/arm64. The FIRST build is slow (several minutes: the
# embedded swagger-ui bundle + sqlite); later applies no-op via the version check
# below. Bump $translateVersion to upgrade -- editing it re-renders this script,
# which is what re-fires the run_onchange. go.mod needs go >= 1.26.4; the default
# GOTOOLCHAIN=auto fetches a newer toolchain if scoop's go is older.
$translateVersion = 'v0.5.2'
Scoop-Install @('go')   # self-contained: installExtraRuntimes may well be off
if (Have go) {
    $trBin  = Join-Path $HOME '.local\bin\translate.exe'
    $trHave = ''
    # `translate --version` prints "translate version v0.5.2 ..."; a module-proxy
    # build carries no VCS metadata, so token 3 is exactly the module version. An
    # absent/unparseable answer just falls through to a reinstall, which is cheap
    # once the module cache is warm.
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $trBin) {
        try { $trHave = ((& $trBin --version 2>$null) -split '\s+')[2] } catch { $trHave = '' }
    }
    if ($trHave -eq $translateVersion) {
        Info "translate $translateVersion already installed"
    } else {
        Info "go install translate@$translateVersion (first build takes several minutes)"
        $env:GOBIN  = Join-Path $HOME '.local\bin'
        $env:GOPATH = Join-Path $HOME '.local\share\go'
        go install "github.com/daviddwlee84/translate@$translateVersion" 2>&1 | Out-Host
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $trBin)) {
            Register-Failure "go:translate@$translateVersion"
        }
    }
} else {
    Register-Failure 'translate (needs go; enable Extra runtimes or run: scoop install go)'
}
{{ end -}}

# Rime (Weasel) on Windows + shared cross-platform Rime config

## Context

The companion Unix repo (`/Users/david/.local/share/chezmoi`) installs Rime on
macOS (Squirrel) and Linux (ibus-rime) via the `installInputMethod` ansible role
— but manages **zero** Rime config. `docs/input_methods/README.md:254-263` there
records an explicit, still-open intent to eventually version-control
`*.custom.yaml`, ranked by priority. This Windows repo has no IME handling at all.

Two goals, one change:

1. Install and configure **Weasel (小狼毫)** — Rime for Windows — on this repo's
   terms (opt-in toggle, fault-tolerant installer, chezmoi-managed config).
2. Establish the **shared Rime config** layer the Unix repo deferred, so 注音 /
   拼音 behave identically on Windows, macOS and Linux.

This is the first place Rime config becomes version-controlled in either repo.

### Why sharing actually works (source-verified)

Weasel's bundled schema set is built from plum `:preset`
(`rime/weasel@master:build.bat:295` → `plum/preset-packages.conf`):
`bopomofo, cangjie, essay, luna-pinyin, prelude, quick, stroke, terra-pinyin`.
That is the **same set** macOS Squirrel ships — the built schemas already on the
Mac (`~/Library/Rime/build/`) match exactly. So a single `default.custom.yaml`
resolves identically on all three platforms with no downloads.

The split:

| File | Portable? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `default.custom.yaml` | ✅ shared | `schema_list`, `menu/page_size` — engine-level |
| `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml` | ✅ shared | schema switch patch — engine-level |
| `weasel.custom.yaml` | ❌ Windows | `style/`, `app_options/` keyed by **.exe name** |
| `squirrel.custom.yaml` | ❌ macOS | `app_options/` keyed by **bundle id** |
| `user.yaml`, `installation.yaml`, `build/`, `*.userdb/` | ❌ never manage | runtime state |

**Rime never rewrites `*.custom.yaml`.** Verified in
`librime@master:src/rime/switcher.cc:165-172` — switch state and the
last-selected schema persist to `user.yaml` under `var/option/…` and
`var/previously_selected_schema`. Confirmed on this Mac: `~/Library/Rime/user.yaml`
holds `zh_hant: true`, `previously_selected_schema: bopomofo`. So plain managed
files are correct here — **no `modify_` overlay** (unlike herdr, which does
rewrite its own config).

---

## Design decisions (source-verified)

**winget package** `Rime.Weasel` — `InstallerType: nullsoft`, `Scope: machine`.
Machine scope means a **UAC prompt**; same class as the existing `installWsl` /
`installSshServer` toggles. The repo's `Winget-Install` already retries without
`--scope user`, but we need a bespoke installer anyway (below).

**Silent install registers Simplified Chinese.** `rime/weasel@master:output/install.nsi:300-330`:
`/S` sets `$R2="/s"` → `WeaselSetup.exe /s` → `install(hant=false, …)`. Passing
`/T` as well flips it: `${GetOptions} "/T"` overwrites `$R2="/t"` →
`install(hant=true, …)`. So `--custom '/T'` is mandatory for 繁體.
Silent mode also skips the 安裝選項 dialog and auto-runs `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.

**`WeaselSetup.exe` has an undocumented CLI** (`WeaselSetup/WeaselSetup.cpp:157-241`),
all HKCU writes needing **no admin**:
`/lt` (UI 繁體) · `/toggleascii` (Ctrl+Space toggles ASCII, not the whole IME) ·
`/userdir:<dir>` · `/du` (disable auto-update) · `/eu` (enable).
`WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy` is the CLI redeploy.

**`global_ascii` + per-app `ascii_mode` compose correctly.** In
`RimeWithWeasel/RimeWithWeasel.cpp`, `AddSession` inherits the global ASCII state
at :174-182, then `_ReadClientInfo` applies `app_options` at :434-440. Later wins
→ terminals/editors stay pinned to ASCII while everything else shares one 中/英
state. `global_ascii` is a **Windows-only win** — the Unix docs record it as
unavailable on Squirrel (`rime/squirrel#201`, `#1054`).

**Font fallback is real**: `WeaselUI/DirectWriteResources.cpp:103` splits
`font_face` on `,`. So a latin-first, CJK-fallback chain works in one key.

**Auto-update check**: not managed (per your selection). Note the silent install
writes `CheckForUpdates=0` on its own (`install.nsi:343-346`); re-enable manually
with `WeaselSetup.exe /eu` if wanted.

## Part A — Windows repo (`/Users/david/src/tries/2026-07-09-windows-dotfiles`)

### A1. Toggle — `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`

Add after `installTranslate`, before `useChineseMirror`. Name matches the Unix
repo's key exactly for cross-repo parity.

\```gotmpl
    # Rime input method (Weasel / 小狼毫). winget's manifest is machine-scope
    # NSIS -> UAC prompt, and its silent path registers SIMPLIFIED Chinese
    # unless the installer gets /T (see the Install-Weasel comment).
    installInputMethod   = {{ promptBoolOnce . "installInputMethod" "Install the Rime input method (Weasel) for Traditional Chinese (needs admin)" false }}
\```

No `=` in the prompt text (invariant #1).

### A2. Shared config bodies — `.chezmoitemplates/rime/`

Same idiom as `.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml` and the shared skill body
(invariant #6). These two files are the **cross-repo shared source**.

`.chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml`:

\```yaml
# Rime — shared, PLATFORM-PORTABLE config. Identical bytes on Weasel (Windows),
# Squirrel (macOS) and ibus-rime (Linux). Do NOT put frontend style or
# app_options here — those go in weasel.custom.yaml / squirrel.custom.yaml.
# Mirror of dotfiles/.chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml.
patch:
  schema_list:
    - schema: bopomofo_tw    # 注音·臺灣正體 (primary)
    - schema: bopomofo       # 注音
    - schema: luna_pinyin    # 朙月拼音
    - schema: terra_pinyin   # 地球拼音 (帶聲調)
    - schema: cangjie5       # 倉頡五代
  menu/page_size: 9
\```

`.chezmoitemplates/rime/luna_pinyin.custom.yaml`:

\```yaml
# 朙月拼音 -> 臺灣字形. switches/@2 is the
# [zh_hant, zh_hans, zh_hant_hk, zh_hant_tw] option group in
# rime-luna-pinyin/luna_pinyin.schema.yaml:27-37; reset: 3 selects 臺灣字形 —
# the same patch rime-bopomofo applies to itself in bopomofo_tw.schema.yaml:8.
patch:
  switches/@2/reset: 3
\```

No per-schema file is needed for `bopomofo_tw` (already 臺灣字形), `bopomofo` /
`cangjie5` (traditional by construction) or `terra_pinyin` (`simplification`
defaults off).

> Your note said "注音 + 拼音" while selecting the option that also includes 倉頡.
> I kept `cangjie5` **last** in `schema_list` and added plain `luna_pinyin`
> alongside `terra_pinyin` (帶聲調 pinyin alone is awkward for daily typing).
> Dropping 倉頡 is a one-line delete.

### A3. Deployed config — `AppData/Roaming/Rime/`

Target is `%APPDATA%\Rime`, Weasel's default user dir
(`WeaselSetup.cpp:103-107`). Source-tree layout matches `AppData/Roaming/alacritty/`
and `AppData/Roaming/television/` — no `dot_` prefix.

- `default.custom.yaml.tmpl` → one line: `{{ template "rime/default.custom.yaml" . }}`
- `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml.tmpl` → `{{ template "rime/luna_pinyin.custom.yaml" . }}`
- `weasel.custom.yaml` → plain file, **Windows-only**:

\```yaml
patch:
  # Latin/label glyphs from the repo's Nerd Font, CJK from 微軟正黑體.
  # DirectWriteResources.cpp:103 comma-splits this into a fallback chain.
  style/font_face: "Hack Nerd Font Mono, Microsoft JhengHei UI"
  style/label_font_face: "Hack Nerd Font Mono"
  style/comment_font_face: "Hack Nerd Font Mono, Microsoft JhengHei UI"
  style/font_point: 14
  style/color_scheme: dark_temple      # stock scheme; see weasel.yaml:66+
  style/inline_preedit: true
  style/display_tray_icon: true

  # One shared 中/英 state across apps (Squirrel can't do this — squirrel#201).
  global_ascii: true

  # ...except these, pinned to ASCII on focus. app_options is applied AFTER the
  # global_ascii inherit (RimeWithWeasel.cpp:174 then :434), so it wins.
  # Windows keys on the EXE name, unlike Squirrel's bundle ids.
  app_options:
    pwsh.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    powershell.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    WindowsTerminal.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    alacritty.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    wezterm-gui.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    herdr.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    nvim.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    Code.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    Cursor.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
\```

`Hack Nerd Font Mono` is already the repo-wide terminal font (alacritty, wezterm,
Windows Terminal, VSCode); `installWindowsApps` installs it via scoop.

### A4. Gate — `.chezmoiignore`

Append at the bottom, in toggle order, with the house-style comment:

# Rime user config is only deployed with the opt-in installInputMethod toggle.
# Weasel reads %APPDATA%\Rime; the sibling runtime files it writes there
# (user.yaml, installation.yaml, build/, *.userdb/) are deliberately unmanaged.
{{ if not .installInputMethod }}
AppData/Roaming/Rime/**
{{ end }}
\```

### A5. Installer — `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl`

Add `#   installInputMethod   = {{ .installInputMethod }}` to the header toggle
list (this is what re-fires the run_onchange).

New `function Install-Weasel` beside `Install-Herdr` (~line 156) — the bespoke-installer
precedent. All failures go through `Register-Failure`; never aborts the apply
(invariant #2):

\```powershell
# --- Rime / Weasel (小狼毫) -------------------------------------------------
# winget's Rime.Weasel is machine-scope NSIS -> UAC prompt. Its silent path runs
# `WeaselSetup.exe /s` = SIMPLIFIED Chinese; --custom '/T' makes install.nsi pass
# /t instead (output/install.nsi:300-306). Silent also skips the 安裝選項 dialog
# and auto-runs WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy.
function Install-Weasel {
    $key = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Rime\Weasel'
    $dir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name InstallDir -EA SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
    if (-not $dir) {
        if (-not (Have winget)) { Register-Failure 'winget:Rime.Weasel (winget unavailable)'; return }
        Info 'winget install Rime.Weasel (machine scope - expect a UAC prompt)'
        winget install --id Rime.Weasel -e --silent --custom '/T' `
            --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
        $dir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name InstallDir -EA SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
        if (-not $dir) { Register-Failure 'winget:Rime.Weasel'; return }
    }
    # HKCU-only tweaks, no admin (WeaselSetup.cpp:196-220).
    $setup = Join-Path $dir 'WeaselSetup.exe'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setup) {
        & $setup /lt           # Weasel UI in 繁體中文
        & $setup /toggleascii  # Ctrl+Space toggles ASCII, not the whole IME
    } else { Register-Failure 'weasel (WeaselSetup.exe not found; language/hotkey unset)' }
}
\```

Gated call block, placed after the `installTranslate` block and before the
`$script:Failures` summary:

\```gotmpl
{{ if .installInputMethod -}}
Install-Weasel
{{ end -}}
\```

### A6. Redeploy — new `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1.tmpl`

Config edits only take effect after 重新部署. Keyed on the YAML content hashes so
it re-fires exactly when the config changes, and ordered after the files land:

\```gotmpl
{{ if .installInputMethod -}}
# Re-runs when any managed Rime YAML changes:
#   default:     {{ include ".chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml" | sha256sum }}
#   luna_pinyin: {{ include ".chezmoitemplates/rime/luna_pinyin.custom.yaml" | sha256sum }}
#   weasel:      {{ include "AppData/Roaming/Rime/weasel.custom.yaml" | sha256sum }}
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
...
# WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy == the tray menu's 重新部署 (WeaselDeployer.cpp:88-91).
{{ end -}}
\```

Resolve `InstallDir` from `HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Rime\Weasel`; warn-and-exit-0 if absent
(Weasel not installed yet, or first apply pre-reboot). Exit 0 unconditionally.

## Approved Plan:
# Rime (Weasel) on Windows + shared cross-platform Rime config

## Context

The companion Unix repo (`/Users/david/.local/share/chezmoi`) installs Rime on
macOS (Squirrel) and Linux (ibus-rime) via the `installInputMethod` ansible role
— but manages **zero** Rime config. `docs/input_methods/README.md:254-263` there
records an explicit, still-open intent to eventually version-control
`*.custom.yaml`, ranked by priority. This Windows repo has no IME handling at all.

Two goals, one change:

1. Install and configure **Weasel (小狼毫)** — Rime for Windows — on this repo's
   terms (opt-in toggle, fault-tolerant installer, chezmoi-managed config).
2. Establish the **shared Rime config** layer the Unix repo deferred, so 注音 /
   拼音 behave identically on Windows, macOS and Linux.

This is the first place Rime config becomes version-controlled in either repo.

### Why sharing actually works (source-verified)

Weasel's bundled schema set is built from plum `:preset`
(`rime/weasel@master:build.bat:295` → `plum/preset-packages.conf`):
`bopomofo, cangjie, essay, luna-pinyin, prelude, quick, stroke, terra-pinyin`.
That is the **same set** macOS Squirrel ships — the built schemas already on the
Mac (`~/Library/Rime/build/`) match exactly. So a single `default.custom.yaml`
resolves identically on all three platforms with no downloads.

The split:

| File | Portable? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `default.custom.yaml` | ✅ shared | `schema_list`, `menu/page_size` — engine-level |
| `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml` | ✅ shared | schema switch patch — engine-level |
| `weasel.custom.yaml` | ❌ Windows | `style/`, `app_options/` keyed by **.exe name** |
| `squirrel.custom.yaml` | ❌ macOS | `app_options/` keyed by **bundle id** |
| `user.yaml`, `installation.yaml`, `build/`, `*.userdb/` | ❌ never manage | runtime state |

**Rime never rewrites `*.custom.yaml`.** Verified in
`librime@master:src/rime/switcher.cc:165-172` — switch state and the
last-selected schema persist to `user.yaml` under `var/option/…` and
`var/previously_selected_schema`. Confirmed on this Mac: `~/Library/Rime/user.yaml`
holds `zh_hant: true`, `previously_selected_schema: bopomofo`. So plain managed
files are correct here — **no `modify_` overlay** (unlike herdr, which does
rewrite its own config).

---

## Design decisions (source-verified)

**winget package** `Rime.Weasel` — `InstallerType: nullsoft`, `Scope: machine`.
Machine scope means a **UAC prompt**; same class as the existing `installWsl` /
`installSshServer` toggles. The repo's `Winget-Install` already retries without
`--scope user`, but we need a bespoke installer anyway (below).

**Silent install registers Simplified Chinese.** `rime/weasel@master:output/install.nsi:300-330`:
`/S` sets `$R2="/s"` → `WeaselSetup.exe /s` → `install(hant=false, …)`. Passing
`/T` as well flips it: `${GetOptions} "/T"` overwrites `$R2="/t"` →
`install(hant=true, …)`. So `--custom '/T'` is mandatory for 繁體.
Silent mode also skips the 安裝選項 dialog and auto-runs `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.

**`WeaselSetup.exe` has an undocumented CLI** (`WeaselSetup/WeaselSetup.cpp:157-241`),
all HKCU writes needing **no admin**:
`/lt` (UI 繁體) · `/toggleascii` (Ctrl+Space toggles ASCII, not the whole IME) ·
`/userdir:<dir>` · `/du` (disable auto-update) · `/eu` (enable).
`WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy` is the CLI redeploy.

**`global_ascii` + per-app `ascii_mode` compose correctly.** In
`RimeWithWeasel/RimeWithWeasel.cpp`, `AddSession` inherits the global ASCII state
at :174-182, then `_ReadClientInfo` applies `app_options` at :434-440. Later wins
→ terminals/editors stay pinned to ASCII while everything else shares one 中/英
state. `global_ascii` is a **Windows-only win** — the Unix docs record it as
unavailable on Squirrel (`rime/squirrel#201`, `#1054`).

**Font fallback is real**: `WeaselUI/DirectWriteResources.cpp:103` splits
`font_face` on `,`. So a latin-first, CJK-fallback chain works in one key.

**Auto-update check**: not managed (per your selection). Note the silent install
writes `CheckForUpdates=0` on its own (`install.nsi:343-346`); re-enable manually
with `WeaselSetup.exe /eu` if wanted.

### A1. Toggle — `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`

### A2. Shared config bodies — `.chezmoitemplates/rime/`

Same idiom as `.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml` and the shared skill body
(invariant #6). These two files are the **cross-repo shared source**.

`.chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml`:

```yaml
# Rime — shared, PLATFORM-PORTABLE config. Identical bytes on Weasel (Windows),
# Squirrel (macOS) and ibus-rime (Linux). Do NOT put frontend style or
# app_options here — those go in weasel.custom.yaml / squirrel.custom.yaml.
# Mirror of dotfiles/.chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml.
patch:
  schema_list:
    - schema: bopomofo_tw    # 注音·臺灣正體 (primary)
    - schema: bopomofo       # 注音
    - schema: luna_pinyin    # 朙月拼音
    - schema: terra_pinyin   # 地球拼音 (帶聲調)
    - schema: cangjie5       # 倉頡五代
  menu/page_size: 9
```

`.chezmoitemplates/rime/luna_pinyin.custom.yaml`:

```yaml
# 朙月拼音 -> 臺灣字形. switches/@2 is the
# [zh_hant, zh_hans, zh_hant_hk, zh_hant_tw] option group in
# rime-luna-pinyin/luna_pinyin.schema.yaml:27-37; reset: 3 selects 臺灣字形 —
# the same patch rime-bopomofo applies to itself in bopomofo_tw.schema.yaml:8.
patch:
  switches/@2/reset: 3
```

No per-schema file is needed for `bopomofo_tw` (already 臺灣字形), `bopomofo` /
`cangjie5` (traditional by construction) or `terra_pinyin` (`simplification`
defaults off).

> Your note said "注音 + 拼音" while selecting the option that also includes 倉頡.
> I kept `cangjie5` **last** in `schema_list` and added plain `luna_pinyin`
> alongside `terra_pinyin` (帶聲調 pinyin alone is awkward for daily typing).
> Dropping 倉頡 is a one-line delete.

### A3. Deployed config — `AppData/Roaming/Rime/`

Target is `%APPDATA%\Rime`, Weasel's default user dir
(`WeaselSetup.cpp:103-107`). Source-tree layout matches `AppData/Roaming/alacritty/`
and `AppData/Roaming/television/` — no `dot_` prefix.

- `default.custom.yaml.tmpl` → one line: `{{ template "rime/default.custom.yaml" . }}`
- `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml.tmpl` → `{{ template "rime/luna_pinyin.custom.yaml" . }}`
- `weasel.custom.yaml` → plain file, **Windows-only**:

```yaml
patch:
  # Latin/label glyphs from the repo's Nerd Font, CJK from 微軟正黑體.
  # DirectWriteResources.cpp:103 comma-splits this into a fallback chain.
  style/font_face: "Hack Nerd Font Mono, Microsoft JhengHei UI"
  style/label_font_face: "Hack Nerd Font Mono"
  style/comment_font_face: "Hack Nerd Font Mono, Microsoft JhengHei UI"
  style/font_point: 14
  style/color_scheme: dark_temple      # stock scheme; see weasel.yaml:66+
  style/inline_preedit: true
  style/display_tray_icon: true

  # One shared 中/英 state across apps (Squirrel can't do this — squirrel#201).
  global_ascii: true

  # ...except these, pinned to ASCII on focus. app_options is applied AFTER the
  # global_ascii inherit (RimeWithWeasel.cpp:174 then :434), so it wins.
  # Windows keys on the EXE name, unlike Squirrel's bundle ids.
  app_options:
    pwsh.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    powershell.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    WindowsTerminal.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    alacritty.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    wezterm-gui.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    herdr.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    nvim.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    Code.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
    Cursor.exe: { ascii_mode: true }
```

`Hack Nerd Font Mono` is already the repo-wide terminal font (alacritty, wezterm,
Windows Terminal, VSCode); `installWindowsApps` installs it via scoop.

# Rime user config is only deployed with the opt-in installInputMethod toggle.
# Weasel reads %APPDATA%\Rime; the sibling runtime files it writes there

### A5. Installer — `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl`

Add `#   installInputMethod   = {{ .installInputMethod }}` to the header toggle
list (this is what re-fires the run_onchange).

New `function Install-Weasel` beside `Install-Herdr` (~line 156) — the bespoke-installer
precedent. All failures go through `Register-Failure`; never aborts the apply
(invariant #2):

```powershell
# --- Rime / Weasel (小狼毫) -------------------------------------------------
# winget's Rime.Weasel is machine-scope NSIS -> UAC prompt. Its silent path runs
# `WeaselSetup.exe /s` = SIMPLIFIED Chinese; --custom '/T' makes install.nsi pass
# /t instead (output/install.nsi:300-306). Silent also skips the 安裝選項 dialog
# and auto-runs WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy.
function Install-Weasel {
    $key = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Rime\Weasel'
    $dir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name InstallDir -EA SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
    if (-not $dir) {
        if (-not (Have winget)) { Register-Failure 'winget:Rime.Weasel (winget unavailable)'; return }
        Info 'winget install Rime.Weasel (machine scope - expect a UAC prompt)'
        winget install --id Rime.Weasel -e --silent --custom '/T' `
            --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
        $dir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $key -Name InstallDir -EA SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
        if (-not $dir) { Register-Failure 'winget:Rime.Weasel'; return }
    }
    # HKCU-only tweaks, no admin (WeaselSetup.cpp:196-220).
    $setup = Join-Path $dir 'WeaselSetup.exe'
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setup) {
        & $setup /lt           # Weasel UI in 繁體中文
        & $setup /toggleascii  # Ctrl+Space toggles ASCII, not the whole IME
    } else { Register-Failure 'weasel (WeaselSetup.exe not found; language/hotkey unset)' }
}
```

Gated call block, placed after the `installTranslate` block and before the
`$script:Failures` summary:

```gotmpl
{{ if .installInputMethod -}}
Install-Weasel
{{ end -}}
```

### A6. Redeploy — new `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1.tmpl`

Config edits only take effect after 重新部署. Keyed on the YAML content hashes so
it re-fires exactly when the config changes, and ordered after the files land:

```gotmpl
{{ if .installInputMethod -}}
# Re-runs when any managed Rime YAML changes:
#   default:     {{ include ".chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml" | sha256sum }}
#   luna_pinyin: {{ include ".chezmoitemplates/rime/luna_pinyin.custom.yaml" | sha256sum }}
#   weasel:      {{ include "AppData/Roaming/Rime/weasel.custom.yaml" | sha256sum }}
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
...
# WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy == the tray menu's 重新部署 (WeaselDeployer.cpp:88-91).
{{ end -}}
```

Resolve `InstallDir` from `HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Rime\Weasel`; warn-and-exit-0 if absent
(Weasel not installed yet, or first apply pre-reboot). Exit 0 unconditionally.

# Weasel (小狼毫) — WINDOWS-ONLY Rime config. Deployed to %APPDATA%\Rime.
#
# Everything here is frontend-specific and deliberately NOT shared with the
# parent repo: `style` keys are Weasel's own, and `app_options` is keyed by
# Windows EXE name where Squirrel keys by macOS bundle id. The portable
# engine-level config lives in .chezmoitemplates/rime/ instead.
#
# Reference for the stock values this patches:
#   https://github.com/rime/weasel/blob/master/output/data/weasel.yaml
patch:
  # Weasel comma-splits font_face into a real DirectWrite fallback chain
  # (WeaselUI/DirectWriteResources.cpp), so latin/digits come from the repo-wide
  # terminal font and CJK falls back to 微軟正黑體. Hack Nerd Font Mono has no
  # CJK coverage on its own; Microsoft JhengHei UI ships with Windows.
  style/font_face: "Hack Nerd Font Mono, Microsoft JhengHei UI"
  style/label_font_face: "Hack Nerd Font Mono"
  style/comment_font_face: "Hack Nerd Font Mono, Microsoft JhengHei UI"
  style/font_point: 14
  style/label_font_point: 14
  style/comment_font_point: 14
  # Stock scheme; other dark options are `starcraft`, `solarized_rock`,
  # `psionics`, `ink`. Full list under preset_color_schemes in weasel.yaml.
  style/color_scheme: dark_temple
  style/inline_preedit: true
  style/display_tray_icon: true

  # One shared 中/英 state across every app instead of per-window. Squirrel
  # cannot do this (rime/squirrel#201, #1054 both closed unmerged), so it is a
  # Windows-only win and stays out of the shared config.
  global_ascii: true

  # ...except these, which start in ASCII on focus. app_options is applied when
  # the client info is read, AFTER a new session inherits the global ASCII state
  # (RimeWithWeasel/RimeWithWeasel.cpp: AddSession then _ReadClientInfo), so the
  # per-app value wins for the apps listed here.
  app_options:
    pwsh.exe:
      ascii_mode: true
    powershell.exe:
      ascii_mode: true
    WindowsTerminal.exe:
      ascii_mode: true
    alacritty.exe:
      ascii_mode: true
    wezterm-gui.exe:
      ascii_mode: true
    herdr.exe:
      ascii_mode: true
    nvim.exe:
      ascii_mode: true
    Code.exe:
      ascii_mode: true
    Cursor.exe:
      ascii_mode: true

```

#Requires -Version 7
{{ if .installInputMethod -}}
# run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1 — 重新部署 Rime after its config changes.
#
# Rime only picks up *.custom.yaml edits on a deploy, so this re-fires whenever
# any managed YAML changes. The hashes below are what makes that happen: they
# change the rendered script, which is what chezmoi's run_onchange keys on.
#
#   default.custom.yaml     {{ include ".chezmoitemplates/rime/default.custom.yaml" | sha256sum }}
#   luna_pinyin.custom.yaml {{ include ".chezmoitemplates/rime/luna_pinyin.custom.yaml" | sha256sum }}
#   weasel.custom.yaml      {{ include "AppData/Roaming/Rime/weasel.custom.yaml" | sha256sum }}
#
# Numbered 50 so it runs after 10_packages has had a chance to install Weasel.
# Like every run-script here it must never abort the apply (invariant #2): a box
# where Weasel isn't installed yet just warns and exits 0.

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false

function Info($m) { Write-Host "==> $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }

$dir = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Rime\Weasel' -Name InstallDir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).InstallDir
if (-not $dir) {
    Write-Warning 'Rime deploy skipped: Weasel is not installed (HKLM\SOFTWARE\Rime\Weasel missing).'
    Write-Warning "Re-run 'just apply' after the Weasel install completes."
    exit 0
}

# WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy is exactly what the tray menu's 重新部署 runs
# (WeaselDeployer/WeaselDeployer.cpp). It takes a single argument and compares it
# with wcscmp, so nothing else may be appended. It also holds an exclusive mutex
# and returns 1 immediately if another deployer is already running.
$deployer = Join-Path $dir 'WeaselDeployer.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $deployer)) {
    Write-Warning "Rime deploy skipped: $deployer not found."
    exit 0
}

Info 'redeploying Rime (WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy)'
try {
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $deployer -ArgumentList '/deploy' -Wait -PassThru
    if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) {
        Write-Warning "WeaselDeployer /deploy exited $($p.ExitCode). If a deploy was already running this is harmless; otherwise redeploy from the tray icon (右鍵 → 重新部署)."
    } else {
        Info 'Rime deploy complete'
    }
} catch {
    Write-Warning "Rime deploy error: $_"
}

exit 0
{{ else -}}
# installInputMethod is off — nothing to deploy.
exit 0
{{ end -}}

```

# Squirrel (鼠鬚管) — macOS-ONLY Rime config. Deployed to ~/Library/Rime.
#
# The counterpart of dotfiles-windows' AppData/Roaming/Rime/weasel.custom.yaml.
# Neither file is shared: app_options is keyed by macOS bundle id here and by
# Windows EXE name there. The portable engine-level config (schema_list, per-
# schema patches) lives in .chezmoitemplates/rime/ and IS shared.
#
# Bundle ids below were read from each app's Info.plist on this machine, not
# guessed. To add one:  osascript -e 'id of app "Foo"'
#
# NOTE: there is deliberately no `global_ascii` here. Squirrel has no such
# option — rime/squirrel#201 and #1054 both attempted it and were closed
# unmerged, and the installed Squirrel binary contains no such key. See
# docs/input_methods/README.md for the full analysis. Windows/Weasel does
# support it, so the two frontends differ here on purpose.
patch:
  # Terminals and editors start in 西文 (ASCII) on focus, so typing commands
  # never needs a manual 中/英 switch first.
  app_options:
    com.apple.Terminal:
      ascii_mode: true
    org.alacritty:
      ascii_mode: true
    com.github.wez.wezterm:
      ascii_mode: true
    dev.warp.Warp-Stable:
      ascii_mode: true
    com.googlecode.iterm2:
      ascii_mode: true
    com.microsoft.VSCode:
      ascii_mode: true
    com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92:   # Cursor
      ascii_mode: true

## 備份策略

這一輪的預設策略是：只備份「手寫設定」與「手動維護內容」，不把所有運行時產物都當成 source of truth。

### Rime：建議備份

優先備份：

- `~/Library/Rime/*.custom.yaml`
- 目前最重要的是 `~/Library/Rime/squirrel.custom.yaml`

如果之後開始客製 schema，也一併把這些視為手寫設定：

- `~/Library/Rime/default.custom.yaml`
- `~/Library/Rime/bopomofo.custom.yaml`
- 其他 `<schema>.custom.yaml`

### Rime：先不要直接納入 chezmoi 的內容

以下檔案不建議直接當成 repo 內主要真相來源：

- `~/Library/Rime/build/`
- `~/Library/Rime/installation.yaml`
- `~/Library/Rime/user.yaml`
- `~/Library/Rime/*.userdb/`

原因：

- `build/` 是重新佈署後的編譯產物
- `installation.yaml` 偏向機器與安裝資訊
- `user.yaml` 偏向運行狀態與最近使用方案
- `*.userdb/` 是 live user dictionary / frequency data，變動頻繁，直接納管很吵

### Rime：`sync/` 的定位

`~/Library/Rime/sync/<installation_id>/` 應該視為同步或匯出產物，不是主要 source of truth。

它有兩個用途：

- 跨機同步時，可作為 Rime 自己輸出的可攜資料
- 在需要救援或搬機時，可作為 userdb 快照與 custom 檔副本

但 repo 策略上，仍建議以手寫的 `*.custom.yaml` 當主要真相來源，而不是以 `sync/` 內容反推設定。

### McBopomofo：建議備份

McBopomofo 官方手冊明確提到：

- 使用者詞彙分頁管理的是純文字檔
- 這些文字檔位置可以自行決定
- 甚至可以放到 Google Drive / OneDrive / iCloud Drive 方便備份

以本機目前狀態，建議優先備份：

- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/data.txt`
- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/data-plain-bpmf.txt`
- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/exclude-phrases.txt`
- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/exclude-phrases-plain-bpmf.txt`
- `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/phrases-replacement.txt`

### McBopomofo：可選備份

可選：

- `~/Library/Preferences/org.openvanilla.inputmethod.McBopomofo.plist`

理由：

- 這裡主要是偏好設定與行為選項
- 對於詞庫與自訂詞本身不是唯一來源
- 如果目標是低噪音、可審查、適合版本控制，文字詞庫的優先級更高

## 之後若要正式納入 chezmoi

這一輪先不把輸入法資料正式納管進 repo，但如果下一輪要做，建議優先順序如下：

1. `squirrel.custom.yaml`
2. 其他手寫的 Rime `*.custom.yaml`
3. McBopomofo 的 `*.txt` 詞庫檔
4. 最後才考慮是否要納入 McBopomofo 的 plist

不建議一開始就把整個 `~/Library/Rime/` 或 `~/Library/Application Support/McBopomofo/` 直接整包納入，因為會混入大量運行時資料。

## 已納入 chezmoi 管理（2026-07-29）

Rime 的手寫設定現在由 chezmoi 管理，而且與 Windows repo

### 可攜：兩個 repo 共用，byte-identical

`.chezmoitemplates/rime/` 是唯一真相來源，兩個 repo 各存一份完全相同的副本：

| 檔案 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| `default.custom.yaml` | `schema_list`（注音·臺灣正體、注音、朙月拼音、地球拼音、倉頡五代）與 `menu/page_size` |
| `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml` | 朙月拼音固定輸出臺灣字形（`switches/@2/reset: 3`） |

之所以能共用：Weasel 與 Squirrel 內建的方案集完全相同（都是 plum 的 `:preset`
套件組 — `bopomofo`、`cangjie`、`luna-pinyin`、`terra-pinyin`、`stroke` 等），
所以同一份 `schema_list` 在三個平台解析結果一致，不需要額外下載方案。

各平台的 renderer 只有一行 `{{ template "rime/<檔名>" . }}`：

- macOS（Squirrel）→ `private_Library/Rime/*.yaml.tmpl` → `~/Library/Rime/`
- Linux（ibus-rime）→ `dot_config/ibus/rime/*.yaml.tmpl` → `~/.config/ibus/rime/`
- Windows（Weasel）→ `AppData/Roaming/Rime/*.yaml.tmpl` → `%APPDATA%\Rime\`

**修改流程**：改其中一個 repo 的 `.chezmoitemplates/rime/`，複製到另一個 repo，
再 `diff` 兩份 — 那個 diff 就是 drift 檢查。

### 不可攜：各平台自己一份

| 檔案 | 平台 | 為什麼不能共用 |
|---|---|---|
| `private_Library/Rime/squirrel.custom.yaml` | macOS | `app_options` 以 bundle id 為 key |
| `AppData/Roaming/Rime/weasel.custom.yaml` | Windows | `app_options` 以 EXE 檔名為 key；`style/` 是 Weasel 專屬 |

一個具體差異：Weasel 支援 `global_ascii`（全域共用中／英狀態），Squirrel 不支援 —
`rime/squirrel#201`、`#1054` 都是關閉未合併，本機安裝的 Squirrel 也找不到這個
關鍵字（見上面「已知限制」）。所以 Windows 那份有這個設定、macOS 這份刻意沒有，
這正是兩個檔案必須分開的實際理由。

### 仍然不納管

`build/`、`installation.yaml`、`user.yaml`、`*.userdb/`、`sync/` 全部維持不納管，
理由同前一節。這點現在是結構性保證而不只是慣例：chezmoi 只管理它自己知道的那幾個
`*.custom.yaml`，同目錄下的其他檔案不會被碰到。

已驗證 Rime 不會回寫 `*.custom.yaml` — 切換狀態與最近使用方案是寫進 `user.yaml` 的
`var/option/…` 與 `var/previously_selected_schema`（librime `src/rime/switcher.cc`
的 `Switcher::SetActiveSchema`）。所以這些可以是一般 managed file，不需要像 herdr
那樣用 `modify_` overlay。

### 改完設定要重新部署

- macOS：從輸入法選單選「重新部署」，或
  `/Library/Input Methods/Squirrel.app/Contents/MacOS/Squirrel --reload`
- Linux：`touch ~/.config/ibus/rime/ && ibus restart`
- Windows：`chezmoi apply` 會自動跑 `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`

Unix 這邊刻意維持手動：Squirrel 的 `--reload` 不夠可靠，而 `ibus restart` 會打斷
當前輸入狀態，都不適合塞進 `chezmoi apply`。

### McBopomofo

McBopomofo 的 `*.txt` 詞庫與 plist 仍未納管，維持前一節的備份建議即可。

    open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(t2)
    print(f'{path}: replaced {end-start} chars with {len(new)}')
PY
